plugins.name: dsh-equip-engine
plugins.description: Task-driven plugin equip engine: dual retrieval (curated rules + LLM semantic), combo scoring (synergy/conflict/cost/trust), conflict detection and install-command export.
plugins.descriptionZh: 按任务自动帮你挑插件：语义检索加规则匹配，算协同与冲突，还能导出安装命令。

plugins.name: dsh-deep-research
plugins.description: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator (workflow engine).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把深度研究变成自适应工作流，自动拆解问题、迭代检索并生成研究报告。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-mover
plugins.description: One-click skill migration into DSH: scans 14 agent platforms (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Trae, Qoder...) plus the shared ~/.agents layer, merges same-name skills, dedupes symlinks and rolls back safely.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键把其他 AI 编程工具的现成技能搬进 DeepSeek Harness，自动去重合并，用错还能随时回滚。

plugins.name: gewu-tools
plugins.description: Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让纯文本模型也能看图：逐页截图 HTML 并生成视觉子智能体简报，再回源码核对验证。

plugins.name: dsh-101
plugins.description: DSH documentation reading mode.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 切换成文档优先的阅读模式，让文档浏览更清爽专注。

plugins.name: dsh_workflow
plugins.description: Dynamic workflow for DSH (placeholder).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 的一次性多 Agent 调度变成可保存、可观察、可恢复的工作流，跑起来更省心。

plugins.name: dsh-toolkit
plugins.description: Zero-dependency tool suite (calculator/csv/diff/encoding/json/markdown/regex/time).
plugins.descriptionZh: 官方零依赖工具包，集计算、编码、JSON、CSV、正则、Markdown、Diff、时间等十个确定性工具，一键安装即用。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add <npm pack 产物 tarball 路径>

plugins.name: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body
plugins.description: Plugin coordination layer: plugins declare their capabilities, commands route to the owning plugin without a model call, tool schemas load on demand to cut prompt tokens, run history consolidates into long-term memory while idle, and failures are classified before any retry.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让插件像器官一样各司其职，命令直达对应插件不耗模型调用，工具按需加载省 token，运行记录自动归并。

plugins.name: dsh-jev-plugin
plugins.description: Opt-in Jev/Luna decision layer for DeepSeek Harness: skill and file selection, task supervision, tool-output filtering, approval assistance and recorded-stage navigation; features are disabled by default.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 智能体加一层「直觉」决策，自动挑选、监督并纠正 Agent 行为，还能管审批。

plugins.name: dsh-claude-move
plugins.description: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (approval-gated, idempotent, resumable sessions).
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键迁移 Claude Code、Codex 等四种工具的会话、记忆和技能到 DSH，支持审批控制、断点续传，迁移更省心。

plugins.name: NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams
plugins.description: Multi-agent team orchestration: captain-style session with durable sub-agent teams, role assignment, and coordinated task execution.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一句话拉起多智能体团队协作，实时查看团队活动面板，让复杂任务自动分工完成。

plugins.name: dsh-track
plugins.description: An embedded task-management engine with decision points, an idea-capture wall, and Linear-style issue storage.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 里内置任务管理引擎，支持决策点、灵感收集墙和 Linear 风格的问题存储。

plugins.name: dsh-deepresearch
plugins.description: DeepResearch plugin (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把证据优先的深度研究工作区带到 DSH，支持持久化工作流状态、模型工具和深度研究 Web 界面，帮你系统化完成多步研究任务。

plugins.name: dsh-task-supervisor
plugins.description: Persistent task supervision with plan coverage review, DAG progress, sidebar consultation, and stage/completion checks; npm development preview.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 任务加上计划审核、进度追踪和完成检查，让长任务跑得更稳更可控。

plugins.name: dsh-jev-preset
plugins.description: JEV agent preset bundle with prompt-guided task routing, cross-verification and quantitative checklists.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 AI 智能体预设一套 JEV 工作流：自动分派任务、交叉验证结果，还用清单量化检查。

plugins.name: dsh-gsd-bundle
plugins.description: Git Ship Done (opengsd-core) reimplemented as host-plane Cordis plugins: replaces the default agent loop with a spec/discuss/plan/execute/verify/ship phase loop.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 GSD 阶段循环搬进 DeepSeek Harness，让智能体按 Git Ship Done 流程干活，替代默认循环。

plugins.name: dsh-todo-guard
plugins.description: Reliable todo panel that survives restarts (official panel only re-renders on write — fixed via projection pre-warm) with three-state completion verification: evidence exists → verified, fake evidence → blocked, no evidence → unverified badge; settings toggle to fall back to official behavior.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让待办面板重启后不丢不白，还能自动核查完成证据，防止假完成。

plugins.name: dsh-dual-model-eval
plugins.description: Runs one coding prompt across multiple configured models in isolated Git worktrees, streams side-by-side tool traces and results, and commits the candidate the user adopts for later rounds.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让多个编程智能体并行跑同一任务，并排对比结果，帮你选出最优代码方案。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-team-gui
plugins.description: Persistent multi-model squads managed in Settings and selected in the Composer; the lead Agent dynamically plans bounded DAG runs with optional review/repair, while Run Center reports DSH's official provider-reported Token usage.
plugins.descriptionZh: 可复用的智能体小队编排工具，支持按角色配置模型路由、工具权限，灵活调度并带网页管理面板。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-arena
plugins.description: Compares coding agents in isolated Git worktrees with deterministic validation, scoring, and explicit winner application.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在隔离的 Git 工作区里让多个编程模型同台比拼，自动验证打分并挑选最优改动应用。

plugins.name: cleverer-dsh
plugins.description: Execution-discipline suite for DSH with identical-retry interception, forced reflection, todo enforcement, memory deduplication, and experience-to-skill promotion (11 plugins + 6 skills).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 更聪明：自动拦截重复尝试、强制反思、管理待办、去重记忆，还能把经验升级成技能。

plugins.name: xiehuan123/coding-coach
plugins.description: Coding Coach: 35-skill bundle plus a full agent preset for non-developers (8-stage idea-to-launch pipeline; engineering/product/UI skills).
plugins.descriptionZh: 不懂代码也能从想法做到上线，35 项技能加教练式引导，全程帮你把产品落地。

plugins.name: february2015/dsh-taskswarm
plugins.description: DSH port of TaskPlane: dependency-ordered waves run in parallel git-worktree lanes, with task packets, cross-model review, and crash recovery.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让多个AI智能体在并行工作区里按依赖顺序协作完成任务，支持任务分派、交叉审查和崩溃恢复，大幅提升开发效率。

plugins.name: dsh-background-agents
plugins.description: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time, with per-child tool scoping, persona and delegation-depth caps.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在官方子代理接口上运行持久后台智能体，随时查看进度、发消息或中断，支持工具权限和角色定制。

plugins.name: dsh-collaboration
plugins.description: Multi-agent collaboration suite: user-configured specialist roster, persistent on-demand dispatch (team_call/team_message/team_status/team_close), clone instances, star-topology relay, model comparison and a multimodal vision bridge.
plugins.descriptionZh: 多智能体协作套件，可配置专家团队，随时召唤成员协作、对比模型，提升任务处理效率。

plugins.name: DSH Automation Center
plugins.description: Workspace automation center for scheduled Agent runs: each execution starts a fresh Result Session with persistent audit history; stock DSH uses a Conversation tab, while compatible Shell slots enable a global page.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给工作区加个定时任务中心，让 Agent 按计划自动跑活，每次执行都留档可查。

plugins.name: Knotline
plugins.description: Visual DSH project map for composing persistent agent workflows from requests, agents, skills, backlogs, approval pools, and scheduled triggers.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 AI 智能体从对话框搬到可视化画布上，用连线编排工作流，让多个 Agent 协作执行任务。

plugins.name: hongyue0721/dsh-kimicode-swarm
plugins.description: Kimi Code Swarm-style batch parallel subagent dispatch: a `swarm_batch` tool fans independent subtasks out to real subagents with two-stage adaptive concurrency (ramp-up plus collision-driven exponential backoff, auto shrink/recover), an in-chat live progress stream (SSE), and `resume_agent_ids` continuation.
plugins.descriptionZh: 批量并行调度多个子Agent，实时显示进度，大幅提升多任务处理效率。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub
plugins.description: A plugin manager and GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace for the DSH Web UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH Web 界面里管理插件、逛 GitHub 插件市场，还能安全升级和回滚。

plugins.name: timwhitez/dsh-self-evolving
plugins.description: Evidence-first, crash-resumable self-evolution engine for DSH: generates bounded Cordis plugin candidates, admits them through a one-shot real Loader, evaluates with Harbor, and journals an auditable lineage.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 插件自我进化：自动生成候选插件、实测验证并记录过程，崩溃后也能接着跑。

plugins.name: bpc-oss/dsh-routed-subagent
plugins.description: Run a one-shot subagent fully mounted on any agent preset from any session, with per-call model/provider override, model pre-check, and external CLI engines (codex / claude / codebuddy) with background jobs, live progress, kill, and continuable sessions.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在任何会话中，基于任意智能体预设快速启动一次性子智能体，支持按次切换模型并提前检查可用性。

plugins.name: Saktawdi/dsh-ha-orchestrator
plugins.description: Model high-availability failover (quarantine, circuit breaking, probe recovery) plus subagent orchestration (fanout/pipeline/supervisor) with a bilingual settings UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek 模型提供高可用故障切换与子代理编排，支持熔断、隔离、自动恢复，并带双语设置界面。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add "file:<本仓库绝对路径>"

plugins.name: zuoyunlai/lunheng-article-pipeline-dsh
plugins.description: Long-form writing pipeline bundle: nine independent roles (literature, data and case retrieval, analysis, drafting, critique, audit, final check, peer review) across six phases with four human checkpoints, triangular evidence verification, a 23-check mechanical final gate, a G0-G14 audit, and peer-review scoring with journal matching. Install: `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline`.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让多个 AI 智能体分工协作，帮你把长篇文章从选题一路写到成稿。

plugins.name: jigjoy-ai/baro-dsh
plugins.description: Baro as a subagent provider: delegate a multi-story goal and get a plan, parallel coding agents, independent per-story review and a verified outcome (tests run, goal invariants attested, merged commits), with a live run panel (phase, stories, milestones) in the sidebar.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在代码仓库里输入目标，自动生成并验证拉取请求，还能在 Mozaik 运行时上测试并发 AI 编程智能体。

plugins.name: bpc-oss/dsh-fork-to-preset
plugins.description: Fork any session into a different agent preset from the conversation header: a preset picker creates a new child session mounted on the chosen preset, inheriting the source session's completed turns.
plugins.descriptionZh: 从对话头部快捷切换不同智能体预设，将当前会话派生为新预设的子会话并保留已有对话，方便对比或继续不同配置的对话。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-tasks
plugins.description: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.
plugins.descriptionZh: 按 cron 定时自动跑提示词，每次开新会话干活，支持工作区绑定和手动触发。

plugins.name: weibaohui/experts-management
plugins.description: Expert manager: manage ntd-format experts and expert teams (plugin.json + Agent MD + skill sets), browse and install from a built-in market of 50+ experts, and run tasks in an expert persona via /expert-<name> without consuming model directory tokens.
plugins.descriptionZh: 管理专家与专家团队，从内置市场一键安装50+专家，还能用专家身份跑任务。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-continue
plugins.description: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) into backoff retry, model switch, resume after compaction, or stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and activity log.
plugins.descriptionZh: 会话中断后自动续跑，按失败原因分类重试、切换模型或恢复上下文，不用手动盯着。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-smart-title
plugins.description: Generates session titles from user and assistant messages using a separate LLM request with a configurable input budget; refreshes after completed turns, preserves manual titles, and skips subagent and fork sessions by default.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动给会话起标题，每轮对话结束后智能刷新，手动改过的标题不会被覆盖。

plugins.name: dsh-zh-thinking
plugins.description: Host plugin that adds Simplified Chinese instructions to the system prompt for planning and tool-call reasoning.
plugins.descriptionZh: 强制 Agent 的思考、规划和工具推理全程用简体中文，防止中文思考漂移成英文。

plugins.name: dsh-product-subagent-console
plugins.description: Conversation-level multi-agent workbench for editable task planning, real child-session observation, plan-versus-runtime comparison, and evidence-backed recovery previews; tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.2.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中规划、运行并对比多个智能体的工作成果，让多智能体协作一目了然。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-commander
plugins.description: Commander mode for DSH Web: inject protocol briefs into the session title bar, parse task blocks from model replies and auto-execute them, separating strategy from execution; activated via a badge button.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把一个对话变成指挥官，自动派活给其他对话并行干活，还能盯着进度收回执。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-process
plugins.description: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate processes; the built-in library is read-only while the personal library is writable with live file sync, and agents read the library through process_* tools and advance work stage by stage.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把多阶段 agent 工艺模板接进 dsh web，可浏览编辑校验、导入导出、AI 生成，还能让 agent 按工艺推进任务

plugins.name: xingzhen199186/dsh-advisor-group
plugins.description: Consults multiple advisor models in one tool call, with auto-deepen follow-up rounds and a streamed chat card.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一次调用就能同时咨询多个顾问模型，还会自动追问加深，并把过程流式展示在聊天卡片里。

plugins.name: pure-craft/dsh-actions
plugins.description: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one layered actions.json (global/workspace/session) served as a right-sidebar run panel and six agent tools, with parameter inputs, approval gates (never/agent/always) and `@actions:` references.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把项目常用操作写成一份 actions.json，人和 AI 都能一键跑，还能加参数和审批。

commands: dsh plugin allow-version dsh-actions@<版本> --dsh-version <你的 DSH 版本> --accept-risk

plugins.name: Awoodwhale/dsh-agent-persona
plugins.description: System-prompt personas scoped by workspace or session: one persona can cover several workspace directories and several sessions, matched exactly, by prefix, by substring or by regex, most specific wins, and one persona can be marked as the default; managed from a settings page and a 「人设」tab on the conversation, effective on the next message.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给不同工作区和会话分别设置 system prompt 人设，在 Web 设置页统一管理。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-thinktank
plugins.description: Applies selected mental models to a question in parallel and combines findings, disagreements, blind spots and action items into a report; supports automatic analysis and prompt-based import.
plugins.descriptionZh: 用144个思维模型多角度分析同一个问题，AI跨模型汇总出共识、分歧、盲区和行动清单。

plugins.name: kotinder/dsh-roomcomm
plugins.description: Connects DSH to shared multi-agent rooms on roomcomm.xyz through a remote MCP server and a coordination skill.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让你的 dsh 智能体加入共享房间，和其他 AI 智能体实时对话协作，零配置开箱即用。

plugins.name: cckyros/goal-acceptance
plugins.description: Acceptance-criteria goal gating: verifiable criteria locked up front, dependency-aware task plans, reviewer-confirmed completion, plus a headless check/status CLI for agent loop hooks (18 MCP tools).
plugins.descriptionZh: 防止智能体提前宣布任务完成，用验收标准驱动目标达成，确保结果真正达标。

plugins.name: billion-context-dsh
plugins.description: Model-driven context compression (ACP) for DeepSeek Harness, ported from billion-context-pi — the model decides when and what to compress.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让模型自己决定何时压缩上下文，大幅扩展对话长度，告别长文本截断烦恼。

plugins.name: xiehuan123/dsh-deepread
plugins.description: DeepRead: deep-reading assistant with five modes (quick/deep/knowledge-map/Feynman reading/book), batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, WeChat links, local PDF (pure-JS extractor), optional MD/FreeMind/HTML export.
plugins.descriptionZh: 深度阅读助手，支持快速/精读/知识图谱/费曼/整本书五种模式，解析微信链接和本地PDF，生成结构化报告并可导出。

plugins.name: ymck-x/dsh-session-continuity
plugins.description: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.
plugins.descriptionZh: 新会话开头自动接上一段，指认上个会话和交接文档，没文档就复用压缩摘要，省 token。

plugins.name: dsh-minimal-first-turn
plugins.description: Minimal-compatible first-turn conditioning for Web root sessions: restricts the prompt and tool catalog to persistent bash and str_replace_editor, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 根会话的首次模型请求更精简，更贴近官方行为，减少不必要的开销。

plugins.name: context-vista
plugins.description: A right-side floating panel and /context command for DeepSeek Harness — a live donut chart of context token usage, allocation, and estimated cost.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在右侧浮窗和 /context 命令里实时看上下文 token 占用、分配和预估花费，环形图一目了然。

plugins.name: context-doctor
plugins.description: See exactly what every request carries: token cost of the AGENTS.md chain, skill catalog and tool schemas, with duplicate/conflict detection and actionable pruning tips (Web UI gauge + context_audit tool, read-only).
plugins.descriptionZh: 审计每次请求的上下文注入，量化token成本，检测重复与冲突，给出精简建议。

plugins.name: dsh-context
plugins.description: Context insight panel: see what the model's context window is made of and how it evolves — composition vs. window size, per-request history, compression/injection events, and per-message token stats.
plugins.descriptionZh: 可视化模型上下文窗口的构成与变化，帮你实时掌握 token 用量、历史记录和压缩注入事件。

plugins.name: dsh-bookmarks
plugins.description: Bookmark finalized assistant replies with notes and tags; a cross-session center with search, tag filter, session jump and one-click Markdown export (Alt+B toggles the panel).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中给每条回复加书签，支持笔记和标签，跨会话集中管理，还能一键导出 Markdown。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-context-compressor
plugins.description: Context compression for small models: compresses tool output and conversation history to a few sentences, freeing context for the actual task; continues in a fresh session automatically.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键把长对话压缩成几句话并自动开新会话继续聊，给小上下文模型腾出空间干活。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add <仓库或本地路径>

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-lens
plugins.description: Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway that searches large remote tool catalogs through two stable interfaces, then calls selected tools with exact schemas, lazy connections and bounded caches.
plugins.descriptionZh: 将上千个MCP远程工具压缩到两个标准接口，大幅降低上下文开销，附赠本地计算器和CI预算控制。

plugins.name: dsh-scope
plugins.description: Context lens: per-session KV cache hit rate and token composition, plus a GitHub-style usage heatmap of daily tokens, sessions, and cache efficiency.
plugins.descriptionZh: 实时查看上下文占用，并用 GitHub 风格热力图回顾 53 周 token 使用趋势，帮你掌控每次对话的“内存”消耗。

plugins.name: dsh-file-mount
plugins.description: Incremental file mounting with read dedupe: mounted line ranges are never re-sent to the model, on-disk changes invalidate and remount, with a Mounted Files tab and token-savings accounting.
plugins.descriptionZh: 文件增量挂载，重复内容不再重发，磁盘变更自动更新，省 token 还能看账本。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-token-viewer
plugins.description: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero with cache-hit rate, trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak pricing, per-project stats, and account balance.
plugins.descriptionZh: 实时查看当前会话及所有会话的 token 消耗和费用，帮你监控资源使用，不发起任何模型调用。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-pro
plugins.description: Persistent enhanced web search for DSH: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cache, userscript-style extraction, Playwright rendering.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 加个增强搜索：多引擎和平台一起搜，结果带缓存还能打包成证据。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-exa
plugins.description: Zero-config Exa web search provider: keyless anonymous MCP fallback (mcp.exa.ai/mcp) plus keyed REST search, for the ctx.web seam.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 补上 Exa 网页搜索能力，无需配置即可匿名调用，也能填 Key 走 REST 接口。

plugins.name: task-passport
plugins.description: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让任务状态在 DSH、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间无缝接力，换工具也不丢进度。

plugins.name: dsh-session-sync
plugins.description: Cross-device session sync: a dedicated git mirror with append-only keep-both conflict resolution, a /sync command and sync_status/sync_pull/sync_push tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 跨设备同步会话，用 Git 镜像自动合并冲突，支持 /sync 命令和同步工具，让多端对话无缝衔接。

plugins.name: dsh-cot-summary
plugins.description: External Summary-CoT plugin workspace.
plugins.descriptionZh: 后台分段总结模型推理过程，生成可恢复的会话摘要，不阻塞主模型。

plugins.name: moguiyu/dsh-tavily
plugins.description: Tavily search with multiple API keys, key rotation/failover, usage gauge, and a settings card for DSH.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索，支持多 API 密钥自动轮换与故障切换，并实时显示用量。

plugins.name: extracurricular-ai/dsh-filesnap
plugins.description: Rewind a conversation and its workspace together without touching Git; every rewind is a fork and /redo reverses it.
plugins.descriptionZh: 不用 Git 也能把对话和工作区一起回退，每次回退自动分叉，还能一键重做。

plugins.name: dsh-free-web-search
plugins.description: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.
plugins.descriptionZh: 无需密钥即可用 Bing、DuckDuckGo 等 10 个搜索引擎，自动切换可用后端，支持时间过滤和平台搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-context-budget
plugins.description: Keeps a local model's context at a size the GPU handles well: measures prefill speed on every request and, before each step, warns or compacts early on a hard token ceiling, an observed time-to-first-token budget, or a predicted cold-prefill budget; /context-budget shows the numbers and the cost of compacting now.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动控制本地模型上下文长度，防止GPU过载，提升推理速度与稳定性。

plugins.name: Kaixxrua/dsh-aigc-radar
plugins.description: Search AIGC Radar's curated GitHub AI project library (500-star admission, bilingual tags, star-growth snapshots) over its MCP endpoint with native result cards; a pre-step listener nudges a reuse check before the agent writes code.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 里直接搜 AIGC Radar 精选的 GitHub AI 项目库，还能顺手提醒你复用已有轮子。

plugins.name: huuthuan-nguyen/dsh-tgrep
plugins.description: Ultra-fast trigram-indexed code search powered by Microsoft tgrep, shadowing the built-in grep tool.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上超快的三元组索引代码搜索，找代码秒出结果。

plugins.name: dsh-context-imports
plugins.description: Claude Code-style `@path` imports for AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md: recursively expands and injects referenced files into model context at session start, with a six-language settings card.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动展开 AGENTS.md 里的 @path 引用，把相关文件在会话开始时一并塞进上下文，省得手动贴。

plugins.name: dsh-simple-memory
plugins.description: Sidecar markdown memory for DSH: per-session index injection, one-click memory-flow button, enforced 分类-主题.md format, cross-project search.
plugins.descriptionZh: 用 Markdown 文件帮你轻松管理 AI 记忆，支持一键注入上下文、按会话自动整理和跨项目快速查找。

plugins.name: dsh-explain
plugins.description: Learning mode that explains each agent step (WIP).
plugins.descriptionZh: 学习模式，逐步解释 AI 代理的每个操作，帮你理解它的决策过程。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-vault
plugins.description: Cross-session memory vault: memory_remember / memory_recall / memory_forget tools, latest entries injected into system-prompt assembly, Settings page (记忆库 / Memory).
plugins.descriptionZh: 跨会话记忆库，让智能体记住历史对话，随时回忆和调用，告别每次从零开始。

plugins.name: dsh-hme
plugins.description: Cross-session long-term memory: bounded core (USER.md global + MEMORY.md per-workspace, φ Fibonacci caps) + a tag-indexed, self-consolidating archive (archive/recall/move tools).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上跨会话长期记忆，让 Agent 记住你的项目、偏好和踩过的坑，不丢不忘。

plugins.name: busabase/busabase-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Connects DSH agents to Busabase knowledge and structured data through MCP, renders records and ChangeRequests in a live inspector, and keeps agent writes behind human review; compatible with DSH 0.1.1-rc.2.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 Busabase 知识库和数据库，让 AI 能查资料、存数据，用起来更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-memoria
plugins.description: Memoria memory backend for dsh: 4 tools (observe/remember/search/recall) into a vector+graph memory layer (memoria) with namespace isolation, auto-write (turn-end observe + positive-feedback -> importance-5 remember) and hot-reload settings.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 dsh 接入 memoria 记忆后端，让会话能记住并回忆信息，支持向量+图检索和命名空间隔离。

plugins.name: weibaohui/context-razor
plugins.description: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes selected entries exactly without LLM summarization.
plugins.descriptionZh: 列出当前会话的上下文条目和 token 估算，标记超标项，并精准删除选中内容，不靠模型总结。

plugins.name: dsh-mnemon
plugins.description: Mnemon-powered local memory system with three-tier storage (runtime hot memory, project Documents, and long-term Memory Spaces), supervised writeback, retrieval tools, and a Web UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 AI 智能体提供持久化记忆层，支持知识图谱和本地优先存储，让对话更连贯。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-memory
plugins.description: Project-level and global long-term memory for DSH Web: isolated POST /items route to avoid path conflicts, multi-turn tool-call context compression before storing entries, deduplication and session-persistent storage.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供长期记忆，自动提取和注入上下文，支持项目级与全局存储，并带 Obsidian 式链接图谱。

plugins.name: dsh-kb-rag
plugins.description: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (PDF/folder/Zotero ingest, hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, scope/strict modes, dedup/clear/stats, DOI fetch, background-job status), all-local bge embeddings + single-file SQLite, measured 242-doc/86s ingest and sub-second hot queries on 20k chunks.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把本地 PDF、文件夹和 Zotero 文献建成知识库，混合检索加引用问答，全程离线跑。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-evolve
plugins.description: Adds long-term cross-session memory with Git-branch awareness and background skill evolution.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 AI 拥有跨会话长期记忆，自动管理待办和技能，还能协同多个 AI 代理干活，越用越懂你。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-gate
plugins.description: Bounded local long-term memory with CBDC (Claim→Belief→Decision→Consumption) authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped dual-channel recall, /memory management commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带权限管控的本地长期记忆，只注入真正需要的记忆，避免上下文污染。

plugins.name: dsh-memento
plugins.description: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: typed ctx.memory seam, zero-dependency SQLite provider, memory tool and frozen snapshot injection, plus the dsh-memory-protocol v1 rehearsal with an adapter registry and a conformance suite.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 AI 助手加上可审批、可审计的跨会话记忆，重启也不忘事。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-auto-translate
plugins.description: Auto-translates English replies inline below the original text, with Chinese annotations for tool calls; translation goes through an independent provider request and never enters the session context.
plugins.descriptionZh: 模型输出全链路自动翻译成中文，思考过程实时翻译，工具调用附中文注释，翻译不占上下文窗口。

plugins.name: url-manager
plugins.description: Agent-first URL collection & knowledge management: save links from any platform, auto-categorize/tag, full-text search, shared categories, and deliver results as magic-link cards. Zero setup — agents auto-register on first use.
plugins.descriptionZh: AI 自动分类整理收藏链接，生成精美卡片，支持共享协作和 Agent 接入，跨平台管理你的知识足迹。
plugins.crossEcosystemHint: 主要面向其他 AI 宿主（如 Claude Code），DSH 兼容性未经验证

plugins.name: dsh-continual-evolve
plugins.description: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompt notes, memories, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 Harness 从会话轨迹里自我进化，提示、记忆、技能都带版本可审计可回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-engramory
plugins.description: File-based curated memory: a line/byte-capped `MEMORY.md` index plus one markdown file per fact, versioned with git and readable without a tool. The cap is enforced through `ctx.tools.guard()` rather than asked for in a prompt, and the protocol is registered as a runtime skill; the same store is also read by Claude Code, Codex, Kiro, and OpenClaw.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 AI 助手加个长期记忆库，每条事实存成 markdown 文件，用 git 管版本，不装工具也能直接看。

plugins.name: dsh-kb-sieve
plugins.description: Knowledge-base plugin: build auditable KB packages (references + SQL).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把文档打包成可审计、可确定性检索的知识库，支持增量构建，纯本地计算，无需外部服务。

plugins.name: plur-ai/dsh-plugin
plugins.description: PLUR persistent memory: engrams are rendered into the system prompt on each assembly rather than sitting behind a tool call, so recall needs no round trip and the block never accumulates in context; fully local search (BM25 + BGE), plain YAML storage you can edit, per-workspace scoping, and a /plur-memory viewer.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让AI记住长期信息，每次对话自动加载记忆，无需额外调用，不占上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-library
plugins.description: Local-first document knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: library_add/remove/list, hybrid semantic+keyword library_search with diversity re-ranking, relevance filtering and lost-in-the-middle avoidance, citation-aware injection, library_cite_check and library_diagnose; SQLite-backed index via the storage domain, local embedding, zero model downloads.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个本地文档库，语义加关键词混合搜索，还能自动去重、过滤和防遗漏。

plugins.name: memory-mcp-server
plugins.description: Layered long-term memory MCP server: raw turns → task fragments → daily summaries → topic indexes, local MiniLM 384-dim embeddings or OpenAI-compatible API backend, semantic + Jaccard-fallback search, one-command DSH plugin install.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 LLM Agent 用的分层长期记忆服务器，把对话沉淀成可语义检索的三层记忆，随时带出完整上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-simple-wiki-memory
plugins.description: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 AI 助手加个轻量 Wiki 记忆，索引自动加载、主题按需读取，省 token 不撑爆上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-porter
plugins.description: Cross-vendor memory migration: zero-token import of the `memories.json` in a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts without an export, and conversations distilled through the host's own model; every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Claude、ChatGPT 里的历史记忆搬进 DSH，逐条带证据、你批准后才入库。

plugins.name: dsh-ragflow
plugins.description: RAGFlow knowledge-base retrieval plugin: gives the agent a `ragflow_retrieve` tool that queries your RAGFlow datasets and returns document chunks with similarity scores and source names; three-role design (seam/provider/consumer), env-based config, `dsh plugin add github:staff-os/dsh-ragflow#main`.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让智能体直接检索你的 RAGFlow 知识库，返回带相似度评分和来源的文档片段，快速接入企业知识问答。

plugins.name: weibaohui/hermes-loop
plugins.description: Automatic post-conversation retrospective that distills useful experience into reusable skills for the skill library, with approval mode and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
plugins.descriptionZh: 对话结束后自动复盘，把有用的经验提炼成可复用技能存进技能库，还支持审批和归档管理。

plugins.name: Mutx163/dsh-model-memory
plugins.description: Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings -> Models, atomic settings.yaml persistence, and per-channel auto-restore of the last model and effort level in new sessions.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置面板里给自定义 API 模型加低/中/高/最高推理档位开关，并跨会话记住你的偏好。

plugins.name: dsh-brainagent
plugins.description: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic / semantic / procedural / emotional memory stores with a reward-ledger and UCB1 bandit loop, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research, and proactive initiatives. Recalled memories ride along in the prompt to your configured provider; license is source-available, non-commercial.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 AI 装上类脑记忆和目标系统，能自主上网探索、靠奖励机制自我学习进化。

plugins.name: dsh-sieve
plugins.description: Filters tool outputs, prunes stale context and discloses skills on demand for DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 智能体做上下文瘦身，过滤工具输出、裁剪上下文、按需加载技能，省 token 又省钱。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sieve@0.4.0 dsh-sieve-web@0.4.0

plugins.name: dearbld/dsh-living-memory
plugins.description: Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file: nightly patrol (dedupe/merge/decay/cross-link), seven-signal RRF recall (FTS5+jieba, optional vectors, graph PPR), typed knowledge graph, conflict detection, web telemetry panels.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上会自我维护的记忆库，自动整理、定期清理，还能用知识图谱帮你更聪明地回忆和检索。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-kb
plugins.description: Team knowledge base for offline knowledge sharing (FDE box scenario): browse, full-text search and refinement entry points; raw material is queued automatically and distilled into wiki pages by a serial bot session (Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern: immutable raw, two-step refinement, log stream, monthly lint).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给团队搭个离线知识库，随时浏览、全文检索和加工资料，写入统一交给 agent 处理。

plugins.name: liustack/modlens
plugins.description: Vision plugin for text-only LLMs: paste images for recognition, multi-image Q&A, screenshot capture, and visual task completion with one-line install.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给纯文本编程助手装上眼睛，粘贴图片即可提取结构化JSON信息，支持OCR、布局和语义分析。

riskyReasons: 含远程脚本下载执行（curl/wget 管道 shell）

plugins.name: dsh-vision-toolkit
plugins.description: Adds image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, visual grounding, pixel diffs, and artifacts.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给纯文本AI装上眼睛，支持图片问答、长截图OCR、界面还原、视觉定位和像素级对比，让智能体看得懂屏幕。

plugins.name: dsh-statecore
plugins.description: Auditable project memory powered by StateCore: auto-ingests messages and injects a budgeted memory digest on each pre-step (re-injected after compaction); five native tools (remember/recall/facts/why/forget) with evidence and supersession chains, embedded SQLite, and MCP access via `statecore-mcp`.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 AI 装个可查证的长期记忆，自动记住对话要点，每步前把关键信息喂回上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-global-rules
plugins.description: Edit your `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` global rules from the Settings page: a text editor with save button, no command line needed.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置里直接用网页编辑器改全局规则，不用敲命令行就能轻松配置 AI 行为。

plugins.name: SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit
plugins.description: Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn; version counter under the bubble, a turn-level version tree of the whole branch family, and ChatGPT / DeepSeek / Claude control layouts.
plugins.descriptionZh: 改一条已发消息就能回退并分叉对话，气泡下显示版本号，还能看整条分支的版本树。

plugins.name: loci-dsh
plugins.description: loci second-brain sidebar tab: hybrid search, cited Q&A, day-grouped memory browsing and quick capture over a local loci knowledge base; proxies `loci serve-http` same-origin from dsh-better-sidebar, no core fork.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 dsh 侧边栏直接搜索、提问、记录你的本地知识库，打造第二大脑。

plugins.name: dsh-keyboard-history
plugins.description: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 会话输入框里用 ↑/↓ 快速翻看历史消息，极简轻量，只靠方向键。

plugins.name: dsh-mneme
plugins.description: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: SQLite + human-editable Markdown mirror, autoDream consolidation, six memory tools, and fully-offline semantic search (local embedding / rerank / clustering), 198 tests.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上跨会话记忆，自动整理沉淀，还能离线语义搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-reference-anything
plugins.description: Extends the native DSH `@` menu with five configurable source groups: commands, skills, workspace files, DSH sessions, and ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/Grok/Kimi conversations; external bodies and attachments are read on demand with per-task authorization.
plugins.descriptionZh: 升级@菜单为全能引用入口，轻松调取文件、命令及跨平台聊天记录，让上下文调用更顺手。

plugins.name: Zhangbo-cn/dsh-voice-input-plugin
plugins.description: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加个麦克风按钮，直接用浏览器语音识别转文字，说话就能写提示词。

plugins.name: dsh-better-sidebar-plugin-office
plugins.description: Office integration for DSH-better-sidebar.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 侧边栏加上 Office 文档处理能力，不用切窗口就能直接查看和操作文档。

plugins.name: dsh-voice
plugins.description: Voice input (speech-to-text) and read-aloud (Edge neural TTS) for the composer.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在输入框里说话就能转成文字，还能把回复朗读出来，语音输入输出一步到位。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-import
plugins.description: Import full-fidelity conversation histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode / ZCode / Grok Build / OpenClaw / Pi / Hermes / Kimi) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export/sync back to Claude Code.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Claude Code 的 JSONL 对话记录（含工具调用和思考过程）导入成 DeepSeek Harness 会话，方便接着聊。

plugins.name: dsh-message-edit
plugins.description: Branch-based message editing / reroll / retry / version timeline.
plugins.descriptionZh: 像分支一样编辑聊天消息，随时重试、重写并回看历史版本。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-studio
plugins.description: Edit system-prompt sections with live preview.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在对话页直接编辑系统提示词，实时预览完整请求效果，支持覆盖原生提示词。

plugins.name: dsh-file-uploads
plugins.description: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在网页端直接上传本地文件，查看待处理卡片，并在设置中管理已存储的文件。

plugins.name: dsh-sticky-note
plugins.description: Quick sticky notes in the composer: ideas/feelings/TODO with Markdown preview, auto-save, one-click send to chat.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在输入框左下角随手记点子、感想和 TODO，自动保存还能一键发到聊天里。

plugins.name: dsh-drag-and-drop
plugins.description: Cross-platform drag & drop with original path insertion.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把本地文件直接拖进来，自动插入真实路径，跨平台都能用。

plugins.name: dsh-pathlink
plugins.description: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中按住 Ctrl 点击文件路径或链接，即可在系统文件管理器中打开对应文件夹，或在新浏览器标签页中打开链接。

plugins.name: dsh-postman
plugins.description: Composer upload of files and folders: images attach as real message blocks, text goes into the draft, folders stored by directory structure.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话里直接上传文件和文件夹，图片自动作为消息块展示，文本进草稿，文件夹按目录结构整理。

plugins.name: dsh-wordbox
plugins.description: Persistent common-word/phrase panel beside the composer input with global/current-project buckets and one-click insert.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在对话输入框旁常驻常用词/短语面板，支持全局与当前项目分组，一键插入，提升输入效率。

plugins.name: dsh-talk
plugins.description: Voice-first session loop: a composer microphone button with browser/local speech-to-text (Web Speech, FunASR, whisper.cpp), a speak tool for text-to-speech replies (browser, edge-tts, piper), event announcements with mute, and speak-to-interrupt.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 支持语音对话，按麦克风说话、听语音回复，还能随时打断重说。

plugins.name: dsh-file-claim
plugins.description: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为并行 DSH 会话提供文件占用与释放保护，支持心跳失效接管和待合并区域管理，避免多会话冲突。

plugins.name: @picgo/dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Official PicGo plugin: upload local files to your image host and get public URLs, reusing the hosts and uploader plugins already configured in PicGo.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中一键上传图片和文件到你的图床，由 PicGo 驱动，方便展示截图和分享内容。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-composer-history
plugins.description: Terminal-style input history for the web composer (edge-first arrows, draft/caret restore, Ctrl+R search, sliding-context awareness) plus a smart input layer: cross-session snippets, prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给网页输入框加上终端式历史记录，方向键翻历史、Ctrl+R 搜索，还能跨会话存片段和提示词模板。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-webspeech
plugins.description: Browser Web Speech API voice input for DSH: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
plugins.descriptionZh: 用浏览器自带的语音识别给 DSH 加语音输入，不用服务器、密钥和模型下载，装上就能说。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-quote-reply
plugins.description: Select text in a conversation, then quote it into the composer or reply in a new window.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在会话里选中文字，一键引用到输入框或开新窗口回复，聊天引用更省事。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-anydoc
plugins.description: This plugin exports a reusable function that takes a file path or a Buffer, extracts the content via @firecrawl/anydoc, and returns GitHub‑Flavored Markdown (GFM). It also includes configuration options and an example usage.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 PDF、Word 等各种文档一键转成 Markdown，让 Agent 直接读懂文件内容。

plugins.name: dsh-dictate
plugins.description: Browser Web Speech dictation for the Composer: recognition needs no dedicated ASR server, key, or model download; reuses Session text and a configured DSH model for contextual phrase hints and optional transcript polishing.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 Composer 里用浏览器语音输入，边说边转文字，还能结合当前会话润色，发送由你决定。

plugins.name: Boliban/dsh-enter-customizer
plugins.description: Take over the system input shortcuts for the chat input box and configure behavior independently for each shortcut.
plugins.descriptionZh: 接管聊天输入框的 Enter 等快捷键，每个键都能单独设置发送或换行，配置自动保存。

plugins.name: dsh-session-archive
plugins.description: Settings section to view archived sessions and permanently delete dead conversations (two-step confirm, running sessions locked).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置页查看归档会话，两步确认永久删除无用对话，运行中的会话自动锁定。

plugins.name: exoticknight/dsh-just-chat
plugins.description: One-click native conversation entry points that create independent workspaces and sessions.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键开启原生对话，每个会话都有独立工作区，聊天互不干扰。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-optimize
plugins.description: Rewrite the current composer draft through an auxiliary LLM call without sending a message.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键调用辅助大模型重写当前草稿，只替换内容不发送消息，方便你反复打磨措辞。

plugins.name: dsh-suggested-replies
plugins.description: Suggested replies above the DSH Web composer.
plugins.descriptionZh: AI 回复完就在输入框上方给出几条你可能想说的话，点一下填进去，不会自动发送。

plugins.name: sayho-pm/dsh-locale-pack
plugins.description: Adds UI languages and translation dictionaries to the DSH desktop app, with English fallback for untranslated strings.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端加上 26 种语言界面，一键切换母语，用起来更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-view-manager
plugins.description: Manage DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session view tabs (Chat / Trajectory): enable, hide, reorder and rename labels, locale-aware (zh/en), with npm update reminders.
plugins.descriptionZh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的视图标签，支持显示/隐藏、排序、重命名，并适配中英文环境。

plugins.name: dsh-history-question-nav
plugins.description: Right-side Questions panel that lists the current session's user questions and scrolls to the matching answer.
plugins.descriptionZh: 右侧列出当前会话问过的所有问题，点一下就能跳回对应回答，长对话找内容不再费劲。

plugins.name: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-split-screen
plugins.description: Split-screen workspace: chat with several agents side by side in native-looking panes, with a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and Alt+Shift+Arrow pane-focus shortcuts. Light/dark.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把多个智能体并排放在一个界面里聊天，分屏操作像原生窗口一样顺手。

plugins.name: fengb3/dsh-theme-macintosh
plugins.description: Classic Macintosh (System 7) pixel theme: desktop pattern canvas, Finder sidebar, monochrome buttons and dialogs, light/dark support.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把界面换成经典 Macintosh System 7 像素风，带桌面图案、Finder 侧栏和黑白按钮，支持深浅色。

plugins.name: dsh-spotlight
plugins.description: Keyboard-first command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供键盘优先的命令面板，快速查找命令、会话、界面操作和插件设置。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-timeline-plus
plugins.description: Message timeline rail with hover Q&A preview (question + reply digest card), panel pinning, day separators, and bookmarks.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给聊天消息加一条时间轴侧栏，悬停就能预览问答摘要，还能钉住面板、按天分隔和加书签。

plugins.name: dsh-scenery-background
plugins.description: Rotating Web UI backgrounds with daily and slideshow modes, five offline SVG scenes, optional Unsplash photos, glass panels, and a floating control.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 Web UI 换上会轮播的风景背景，支持每日一图和幻灯片模式，内置五套离线场景，还能接 Unsplash 图库。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add "file:/绝对路径/dsh-scenery-background"

plugins.name: dsh-catppuccin
plugins.description: Catppuccin theme plugin: Latte / Frappé / Macchiato / Mocha skins for the DSH Web theme runtime.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上 Catppuccin 柔和粉彩主题，界面更护眼更治愈。

plugins.name: dsh-skin-studio
plugins.description: Local semantic-token theme editor with palette extraction, WCAG auditing, preview, and export.
plugins.descriptionZh: 本地优先的 DSH 主题生成器，支持创建、编辑、预览、导入导出明暗主题，全程无需联网，安全放心。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-zh-tw
plugins.description: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) locale edition of DeepSeek Harness: adds a third UI language option with Taiwan terminology across all 25 web UI packages.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供台湾繁体中文界面，覆盖全部 25 个 Web UI 组件，让中文用户操作更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-sticky-disclosure
plugins.description: One-click collapse of every expanded section in the DSH Web UI (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键收起 DSH 网页里所有展开的思考行和工具卡片，带实时计数和自定义快捷键。

plugins.name: dsh-better-model-selector
plugins.description: Splits the composer model selector into a searchable, favorite-marking dropdown and a reasoning-effort slider, with Ctrl+P / Ctrl+T quick-switch shortcuts.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把模型选择器拆成可搜索收藏的下拉框和思考强度滑条，还能用快捷键快速切换。

plugins.name: dsh-appearance
plugins.description: Unified appearance coordinator: theme color presets, UI fonts, UI font size, plus per-workspace markdown font size / line-height / background, with a coordination layer that stops UI scaling from leaking into chat body text.
plugins.descriptionZh: 统一管理界面主题、字体和字号，并让聊天正文样式不再被界面缩放干扰，告别样式冲突。

plugins.name: solarized-dsh-theme
plugins.description: Solarized + Selenized theme plugin: four faithful palettes registered into the DSH Web theme runtime.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Solarized 和 Selenized 两套经典配色主题，内置四种精准调色方案，并附带设置面板和代码块语法高亮，让界面更护眼、更美观。

plugins.name: pbr-render
plugins.description: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe) via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在对话里直接预览PBR游戏模型，支持贴图、环境光和材质通道检查，方便快速查看3D资源效果。

plugins.name: dsh-view-modes
plugins.description: DSH Web output modes with Verbose, Normal, and Summary views, semantic grouping for tool calls and thinking, and live execution status.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH Web 提供详细、标准、摘要三种输出模式，按语义分组展示工具调用与思考过程，并实时显示执行状态。

plugins.name: arcana
plugins.description: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把所有斜杠命令变成悬浮按钮面板，按使用频率排序，点一下就能运行。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-workshop
plugins.description: Steam Workshop-style in-app plugin browser: search, hot/newest/trending windows, Chinese keyword mapping, bilingual translation, plugin-signature filtering, and smart one-click install/update/uninstall with an installed-plugins manager.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 侧栏里像逛创意工坊一样搜插件、看热门榜，一键装好或更新，零配置开箱即用。

commands: dsh plugin add 会自动把它加入 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles，

plugins.name: dsh-web-review
plugins.description: Embeds isolated web page previews in DSH Web for element annotations and visual adjustments that guide source edits.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在内置浏览器里像用设计工具一样选中网页元素、写修改意见并临时调样式，确认后让 Agent 按批注改源码。

plugins.name: dsh-aigc-canvas
plugins.description: AIGC canvas plugin (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在画布上直接生成和编辑 AIGC 图像，让创作更直观顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-design-studio
plugins.description: Design Studio tab: design briefs become html/css/js mockups with live preview, element picker, design-agent chat with vision review, identity presets and zip export.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把设计稿变成可交互的网页原型，实时预览、AI 视觉审稿，还能一键打包导出。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-menu
plugins.description: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 主页右键或双击工作区/会话，快速置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、复制链接或新窗口打开，管理更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile client plugin (cordis + dsh.plugin.json).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH WebUI 适配到手机窄屏，用横向翻页卡片加半开侧边栏，手机上也能顺手操作。

plugins.name: dsh-markdown-preview
plugins.description: In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text in the conversation, with system-app open kept one click away.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在对话中直接预览生成的 Markdown、图片或纯文本文件，无需下载，一键打开系统应用。

plugins.name: dsh-i18n
plugins.description: Chinese localization for tool results: intercepts tool execution output and translates English markers (`[exit code]`, `[timed out]`, `[sandbox: ...]`, etc.) into Chinese, with a settings toggle.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把工具执行结果里的英文标记自动换成中文，带设置开关，看输出不再费劲。

plugins.name: dsh-diff-viewer
plugins.description: PiUI-style Web diff viewer replacing the default diff view.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 里 write/edit 的 diff 换成 PiUI 风格网页视图，代码改动看得更清楚。

plugins.name: dsh-openpencil
plugins.description: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接预览和编辑 OpenPencil 设计稿，让设计调整更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-ultra-ui
plugins.description: Ultra UI plugin (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把各种插件的工具调用收成紧凑可展开的折叠行，随时回放查看，界面清爽不刷屏。

plugins.name: dsh-skin
plugins.description: Codex-style skin switcher + custom wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: curated --dsw-alias-* palettes, translucent main canvas/sidebar (overrideTokens) with opacity and blur controls.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 网页界面换肤，内置多套 Codex 风格配色，还能自定义壁纸和半透明毛玻璃效果。

plugins.name: dsh-settings-tuner
plugins.description: System parameter adjustment UI: grouped settings page for timeouts, parallelism, LLM retry policy, model params, web search, permissions and presets; safe profile-config editing with line-level YAML matching and post-write validation.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置页集中调整超时、并行、重试、模型等系统参数，改配置更安全省心。

plugins.name: @zhaoolee/dsh-notes
plugins.description: Export DSH conversations as Smartisan Notes-style PNGs, or create and update Markdown notes in a configured account-scoped workspace.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 对话导出成锤子便签风格的 PNG，也能在工作区里新建和更新 Markdown 笔记。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-list-plus
plugins.description: Trust-tiered, collapsible plugin list with comprehensive per-plugin details for Web Settings.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页设置提供分级信任、可折叠分组的插件列表，并展示每个插件的完整详情。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-description
plugins.description: Adds bilingual (zh/en) descriptions to every plugin card on the Web Settings plugin list; publishes a `pluginDescriptions` service for other plugins to register their own.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 插件列表里的每张卡片补上中英文功能说明，挑插件不再靠猜，还能让其他插件注册自己的描述。

plugins.name: dsh-builtin-toggles
plugins.description: Human-readable catalog for official DSH Web built-ins with status explanations and an audited set of safe UI toggles.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH Web 官方内置功能整理成看得懂的清单，还能安全开关部分界面选项。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-smooth-stream
plugins.description: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的流式输出更顺滑，打字机效果不再卡顿跳字，聊天阅读体验更舒服。

plugins.name: dsh-smooth-stream
plugins.description: Silky streaming reveal for the Web UI: text appears at the model's arrival rate, new lines glide in, no flicker; follow stays with the user and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 AI 长文像提词器一样顺滑流出，逐行滑入不闪烁，跟随不抢屏。

plugins.name: dsh-split-panes
plugins.description: Split panes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把对话信息流拆成多个独立窗格，每个窗格绑定自己的会话，可四向拖拽分屏，多任务并行不打架。

plugins.name: dsh-file-mentions
plugins.description: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, 📂 reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击，支持内联打开、在文件管理器中显示，并在回复末尾汇总提及的文件列表。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-plugin
plugins.description: A DSH Web GUI theme studio with presets, custom palettes, and instant theme switching.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供主题工作室，内置多套预设并支持自由定制明暗配色、字体和半透明侧边栏。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-panel
plugins.description: MCP management console for the official DSH MCP client: server CRUD with approval-gated, backed-up profile writes, a tool trial console through the official tool pipeline, health diagnostics, and connection status.
plugins.descriptionZh: DSH 官方 MCP 客户端的管理控制台，支持服务器增删改查、工具试用、健康诊断与连接管理，让 MCP 配置更安全省心。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-switch
plugins.description: Minimal on/off loop: a desktop shortcut launches dsh web, and an animated whale button (hover to arm, click to dive) shuts it down gracefully and closes the tab.
plugins.descriptionZh: 桌面快捷方式一键启动 dsh web，点鲸鱼按钮优雅关闭并收起标签页，开关闭环超省心。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-colorscheme
plugins.description: Web UI colorscheme plugin: switch and persist themes from Settings, with 8 built-in open-source presets plus custom themes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多款知名配色主题，一键切换并自动保存，刷新后不丢失。

plugins.name: dsh-premium-themes
plugins.description: 8 curated color schemes plus custom palette import (name + scheme + seed colors derive a full token map), a Palette row in General settings, hot-plug install.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 dsh 网页端提供 8 套精选配色，支持导入自定义色板，一键热插拔切换主题，无需改动核心。

plugins.name: dsh-session-pin
plugins.description: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the sidebar with per-pin colors, plus a navigation organizer: boards, tags and saved views, health summaries, and /goto.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把会话和工作区固定到侧边栏顶部，支持彩色标记，还能用看板、标签和快捷跳转来整理导航。

plugins.name: turtle-ui
plugins.description: Official UI plugin reference implementation.
plugins.descriptionZh: Turtle UI 是 DSH 官方的终端界面插件，提供简洁美观的交互界面，方便你更直观地操作和管理插件。

plugins.name: RevolutionLA/dsh-dream-skin
plugins.description: One-command skinning for DSH Web: 8 original themes, wallpaper (opacity/blur/gradient/URL), per-user accent, and shareable theme packs + favorites + surprise-me. Purely native token system.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一条命令给 DSH Web 换肤，自带 8 套主题、壁纸和专属配色，还能分享主题包。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dream-skin && dsh web
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dream-skin@<最新版本>

plugins.name: dsh-homepage-skin
plugins.description: Brings the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to DSH Web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital whale, with dark and light palettes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 dsh web 界面换上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景，流体光效加数字鲸鱼，深浅两套配色随便挑。

plugins.name: Open Sea Skin
plugins.description: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin with lower-left controls for waves, daylight, glass opacity and automatic day cycling; tested on DSH Web 0.1.0-rc.6.
plugins.descriptionZh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋皮肤，左下角可调波浪、日光和玻璃透明度，支持自动昼夜循环，让新标签页沉浸感拉满。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-help
plugins.description: Installed-plugins README summary panel: floating 📖 button, zh-preferring titles, default-all-expanded READMEs, blue circular index badges, per-plugin one-click update (`dsh plugin update`) via a loopback endpoint.
plugins.descriptionZh: 右下角常驻📖按钮，一键汇总查看所有已安装插件的操作说明，默认全部展开，支持快速更新。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-indent
plugins.description: Indents every tool call in the Web conversation, with a settings page for tool/thinking summary indent, dimming, and line spacing.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 网页界面里所有工具调用加缩进，还能在设置里调缩进、灰度和行间距，让对话层次更清楚。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-manager
plugins.description: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a bold high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light & dark).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页换个皮肤，先选文化场景再挑风格，内置水墨、浮世绘、赛博朋克等40款主题。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-settings-ui
plugins.description: Customizes the DSH native settings window: preset or custom sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a floating ball for quick access; saved in the local browser.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自定义 DSH 设置窗口的大小、全屏、透明度和主题背景，还能用悬浮球快速打开。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-mini-manager
plugins.description: Minimal skill manager for DeepSeek Harness Web Settings: lists installed skills with summaries, sources and disk usage, and moves eligible filesystem skills to a recoverable trash while protecting bundled and system skills.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 设置里一眼看清装了哪些 skill、各自多大占多少空间，不想要的还能直接删掉并支持恢复。

plugins.name: qiweiii/dsh-brand-studio
plugins.description: In-app branding panel for the DSH Web and Desktop UI: brand name and badge, local logo and wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page title, and reset to the official look.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页、PWA 和桌面端换个品牌名、徽章和 logo，还能随时恢复官方外观。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-hub
plugins.description: Search, show, hide, move, resize and arrange plugin controls in DSH Desktop and Web, with layout backup, restore and undo.
plugins.descriptionZh: 统一管理 DeepSeek Harness 桌面和网页端的插件控件，可搜索、显隐、移动缩放和排列布局，还能备份恢复。

plugins.name: rex178178/dsh-turnbar
plugins.description: Video-style turn navigation for the DSH Web UI: a full-map progress bar (150+ turns aggregate into ≤40 groups), hover preview cards (first lines, tool calls, file edits, token usage), drag scrub, ⌘K search across the whole session including history beyond the loaded window, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping and Esc-return.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给对话加一条进度条，能悬停预览、拖动跳转、⌘K 搜索，随时回到任意一轮。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-mover
plugins.description: True in-place migration of sessions across workspaces: drag-and-drop, bulk/group merge, orphan rescue panel, workspace repoint wizard, recycle bin with restore, byte-level backup with stepwise rollback and post-move verification, plus dsh-tools agent tools (npm: dsh-workspace-mover).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在侧边栏把会话拖到另一个工作区，真正迁移原始档案而不是复制，方便整理多工作区内容。

plugins.name: zhao-guang-ai/dsh-quote-annotate-pro
plugins.description: Selection quoting and anchored annotations with source-message navigation, turn and role labels in sent quotes, and localStorage persistence; localhost diagnostic requests are enabled by default.
plugins.descriptionZh: 选中消息内容即可引用并加锚点批注，还能跳回原消息，引用里带轮次和角色，刷新也不丢。

commands: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本仓库绝对路径>

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-no-workspace
plugins.description: Standalone workspace-free conversations with lossless detach and direct top-level sidebar rendering, without replacing DSH's native workspace UI (npm: dsh-plugin-no-workspace).
plugins.descriptionZh: 免选工作区直接开聊，独立会话平铺在侧边栏，原生界面不受影响。

plugins.name: dsh-office
plugins.description: Office workspace & session dashboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents — plus Agent Mail, Feishu/Lark message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts and an office log tab.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中悬浮展示工作区、会话、Token 用量和子代理状态的 6 列可视化面板，让你一眼掌握全局。

plugins.name: dsh-token-pet
plugins.description: Cute token-usage pet in the session header: live context occupancy, per-session usage and breakdown, plus date/weekday, weather, 3-day forecast and severe-weather alerts, all theme-aware.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在会话栏养只可爱小宠物，实时看上下文占用和用量，还能顺手查天气和预报。

plugins.name: dsh-pin-recall
plugins.description: Pin assistant replies from the Web action strip and recall them into the next model turn (`/pin` `/recall`, with optional wake).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中固定助手回复或工具证据，一键召回并注入下一轮对话，支持网页按钮快捷操作。

plugins.name: dsh-fork-graph
plugins.description: Git-style conversation fork graph in the session header: colored lanes and fork curves show which session branched from which, with click-to-jump navigation.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 会话的分叉历史变成 Git 分支图，彩色泳道一目了然，点击即可跳转，轻松管理多线对话。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-quota
plugins.description: Displays remaining DeepSeek API balance in an auto-refreshing DSH Web floating card.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页界面挂个悬浮卡片，实时显示 DeepSeek API 剩余余额和今日用量，自动刷新。

plugins.name: chouyong/dsh-branch-review
plugins.description: Track human decisions for related DSH session branches: keep, discard, or follow up with reasons, labels, and external links.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把会话分支的比较结果变成人工决策队列，记录保留、淘汰或跟进及理由标签链接。

plugins.name: dsh-fork-diff
plugins.description: Read-only parent and sibling branch comparison in DSH Web: message and tool diffs, usage and latency summaries, filters, and open-session navigation.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH Web 里只读对比父分支和兄弟分支，一眼看清消息、工具调用和耗时的差异。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage
plugins.description: Codex-style token usage panel: whole-instance cumulative/per-session peak tokens, longest chat & streak, daily/weekly/cumulative activity heatmap, and plugin/skill Top5.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把整个 DSH 实例的 Token 消耗做成 Codex 风格面板，累计峰值、热力图、插件 Top5 一眼看清。

plugins.name: dsh-session-tree
plugins.description: Read-only session lineage tab for DSH Web: browse the current root, fork, and subagent family as a bounded tree and click any node to navigate.
plugins.descriptionZh: 只读查看当前会话的 fork 树，在父会话、兄弟分支和子会话之间一键跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-meter
plugins.description: Per-session and daily API cost, budget with usage %, official balance, history dashboard, and one-click official price sync with peak/off-peak pricing.
plugins.descriptionZh: 实时统计每次会话和每天的 API 花费，设置预算看用量，还能同步官方价格和余额。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-meter
plugins.description: Live DeepSeek account balance and session cost in the DSH Web composer dock, with auto-fetched official pricing and peak/off-peak support.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页编辑器里实时查看 DeepSeek 余额和会话花费，自动获取官方价格，支持高峰/低谷计费。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-navigator
plugins.description: DSH Web turn navigation plugin.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在长对话中快速定位和跳转到指定轮次，悬停预览，点击直达，提升浏览效率。

plugins.name: TokenLedger
plugins.description: Local DSH token usage by relay site, project, and model, with account balances and subscription quota windows.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在本地统计各中转站、项目和模型的 DSH token 用量，还能看账户余额和订阅额度。

plugins.name: Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-cachebilling
plugins.description: Per-round cache billing inside the composer context-meter popover: what the current call spends on cache hits, misses, and output in CNY, with automatic official peak/off-peak and per-model pricing; hidden on non-official DeepSeek routes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在输入框里实时显示每轮对话的缓存命中、未命中与输出花了多少人民币，帮你及时发现该换窗口省钱了。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-panel
plugins.description: Token usage statistics as a Settings page: cumulative KPIs aligned with the visible session list, a six-month activity heatmap, stacked per-model daily bars, a model donut, top sessions and JSON/CSV export; incremental projection over session logs with fork/seed history deduplication, strictly read-only.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置页查看Token用量统计：累计指标、六个月活跃热力图、每日模型用量柱状图和占比环图，数据自动从会话日志中读取。

plugins.name: dsh-usage
plugins.description: DeepSeek account-wide usage & balance panel from the official platform API (api/v0/usage/by_api_key): cache hit/miss & output tokens, cost, 24h–90d ranges, persistent platform token, and a model-visible `deepseek_usage_query` tool.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 里直接查看 DeepSeek 账户余额和全平台 Token 用量，连网页端调用也算得清清楚楚。

plugins.name: fancr-code/dsh-plugin-usage-meter
plugins.description: Usage/cost/balance meter in the composer dock: button-style chip with live peak/off-peak pricing tags, today/last-7-days per-model stacked bar charts, budget alerts, and a persistent cross-session ledger.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在输入框旁实时显示用量、花费和余额，带峰谷价标签、分模型图表和预算提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage-dashboard
plugins.description: Codex-style token usage dashboard: five stat cards, GitHub-style activity heatmap (daily/weekly views), insights & model ranking; persisted snapshot with incremental sync, survives session deletion.
plugins.descriptionZh: 像 Codex 一样直观展示 Token 用量：统计卡片、活动热力图、模型排行，数据自动同步，不怕会话丢失。

plugins.name: dsh-web-billing
plugins.description: RMB/USD token billing for the DSH web: official-policy auto pricing (incl. peak/off-peak hours), per-message cost ledger, account balance, locale-driven currency display.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 网页版算钱：按官方价自动计费，逐条消息记账，还能看余额和人民币/美元显示。

plugins.name: dsh-budget
plugins.description: Cost governance for DeepSeek Harness: aggregated token/cost metering per model, session and day, session/daily/monthly budget caps with threshold alerts and alert/block/degrade over-limit policies, carbon footprint estimation, per-model latency benchmarks, a Settings budget tab, and the /budget command.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供成本治理面板，实时统计各模型、会话和每日的 Token 消耗与费用，支持预算上限、超限告警和碳足迹估算。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-cost
plugins.description: Session cost estimate in the DSH Web composer dock (tokenUsage × configurable price table, one-click official-price refresh).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页版聊天框下实时估算会话费用，按官方价格表计算，支持一键刷新最新价格。

plugins.name: dsh-linked-folders
plugins.description: Multi-folder workspace: a global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为会话提供多文件夹工作区，支持全局链接列表和即时挂载/卸载文件夹，方便在侧边栏管理多个目录。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-meter
plugins.description: Per-turn USD cost in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown (token usage × configurable pricing table).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 Web 界面实时显示每轮对话和整个会话的美元费用，悬停可查看 token 用量和价格明细。

plugins.name: dsh-spend
plugins.description: Token usage and estimated spend statistics for the DSH web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session views.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页界面里实时查看各模型、每天和每次会话的 Token 用量与预估花费。

plugins.name: dsh-tmux-cc
plugins.description: Persistent tmux control-mode cockpit for DSH Web that mirrors native panes in a dock.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 tmux 会话搬进 DSH Web，用 xterm.js 还原每个窗格，随时接管终端不丢状态。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-tide
plugins.description: DeepSeek account balance and session cost under the composer, with a live peak/off-peak pricing badge (Beijing time), a countdown to the next pricing switch, and hover price tables with usage advice.
plugins.descriptionZh: 实时显示 DeepSeek 余额与本次会话花费，并智能提示当前峰谷计价档位、切换倒计时及省钱建议。

plugins.name: dsh-worktime-board
plugins.description: Agent worktime dashboard: floating day/week/month stats, multi-dimension heatmap, thread attendance Gantt, school-year calendar, and a 12-realm xianxia score system for agent activity.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Agent 的工时统计做成修仙看板，日周月悬浮数据、热力图、甘特图和学年日历一眼看清。

plugins.name: dsh-outline
plugins.description: Real-time conversation outline panel for the DSH Web session page: a tree of user questions and Markdown headings (H1-H6) that updates live while streaming, with click-to-jump highlight, expand-depth control, search, and per-session favorites.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH Web 会话页实时生成对话大纲树，问题与 Markdown 标题随流式输出同步更新，点击即可跳转定位。

plugins.name: dsh-milestone
plugins.description: Right-side dot-timeline rail to jump between user messages.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在会话右侧加一条时间轴导航条，像 Git 提交图一样快速跳到任意一条用户消息。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-continue
plugins.description: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network/timeout/host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications; everything configurable from the plugin settings card.
plugins.descriptionZh: 网络中断或超时后自动重发「继续」，智能分类错误并自适应等待，让 DeepSeek 网页请求不中断。

plugins.name: Chu-m/dsh-chat-continue
plugins.description: Auto-retries failed API requests to keep DSH conversations running, with configurable HTTP status and error-code rules.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动重试失败的API请求，解决限流和临时错误，让对话不中断。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-flow
plugins.description: Live execution flowchart tab for the current session: context/user/assistant/tool swimlanes with approval diamonds, subagent fan-out with double-click drill-down, and a compact list view, streamed over SSE as the session runs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在会话里实时画出执行流程图，泳道展示上下文、用户、助手和工具调用，支持审批节点与子智能体下钻。

plugins.name: dsh-web-attention-badge
plugins.description: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count and whale-favicon recolor for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
plugins.descriptionZh: 当会话等待输入或结果未读时，自动在页面边框、标签页标题和浏览器图标上显示提醒，让你不错过任何需要关注的任务。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-index
plugins.description: A turn-index sidebar listing every user turn, with click-to-jump navigation and scroll-spy highlighting.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在聊天界面右侧加一条轮次索引栏，点哪轮就跳到哪轮，滚动时还会自动高亮当前轮次。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-mode
plugins.description: Preset-mode badge embedded in the "New Session" button: click to pick the default agent preset for the next session (long names truncate with ellipsis so the label stays readable).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把模式切换塞进新会话按钮，点一下就能选标准/PTC/创造/极简，不用再进设置页，新会话创建更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-conversation-anchors
plugins.description: Sidebar conversation anchor navigation: one anchor per chat node (user / assistant / tool / command) with role badges and summaries, click to smooth-scroll to that message; live-refreshes with the session.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在侧边栏生成会话锚点目录，点击即可快速跳转到任意对话消息，浏览长会话更省心。

plugins.name: dsh-hud
plugins.description: HUD status panel: git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在侧边栏实时显示 Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能、模型和 Token 用量，让你随时掌握开发环境全貌。

plugins.name: dsh-plan-switch
plugins.description: One-click enter/exit Plan mode for the DSH web input bar, a quick-click shortcut for /plan.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页输入栏一键进入或退出 Plan 模式，省去输入 /plan 的麻烦，快速切换规划状态。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-continue-on-limit
plugins.description: Auto-sends continue when a local model hits its output-token cap: dual-source detection (turn-max-tokens node + provider response), maxConsecutive guard (default 3) prevents infinite loops.
plugins.descriptionZh: 本地模型输出被 token 上限截断时自动发送「继续」，让回复接着写，不用手动点。

plugins.name: dsh-trajectory-debug
plugins.description: Trajectory waterfall, deterministic replay, breakpoints, edit-and-rerun, fork compare and performance analytics for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 会话变成可视化调试台，支持断点回放、改完重跑和分支对比，让 AI 轨迹调试像写代码一样顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-netcafe
plugins.description: Hosted outcome tools bundle (MCP over one config row): md→docx/pptx/pdf, tables with in-code arithmetic checks, China-reachability testing from a real mainland vantage, Chinese calendar/holidays; free anonymous quota, per-call cost reporting.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一站式工具包：文档格式转换、表格公式校验、国内网络连通性测试、农历节假日查询，免费开箱即用。

plugins.name: dsh-opencodego-usage
plugins.description: An OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI with rolling, weekly, and monthly usage views.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页界面实时显示 OpenCodeGo 剩余配额，用呼吸灯和进度条直观呈现用量，方便你随时掌握额度。

plugins.name: dsh-trajectory-reader
plugins.description: A 轨迹解读 (trajectory interpretation) tab that summarizes each user round — what was wanted, how the assistant thought and executed, files/commands/errors — via a rules engine plus optional LLM narrative; user messages stay verbatim.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中逐轮回看对话，自动总结用户意图、助手思考与执行过程，并标出文件、命令和报错，帮你快速复盘。

plugins.name: DSH-better-sidebar
plugins.description: Sidebar: file rendering/terminal/Git/subagents/custom APIs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 加个右侧边栏和底部面板，文件、终端、Git、子代理都能在这儿看和操作。

plugins.name: dsh-session-manager
plugins.description: Right-click context menu on sidebar conversation rows: pin, rename, archive, fork, mark unread, copy cwd/id/title/deep-link, open in explorer/new window.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页侧边栏的对话列表上右键，快速管理会话，并一键打开会话管理器。

plugins.name: penguin-oo/dsh-quota-hub
plugins.description: Unified real-time quota dashboard: one collapsible glass panel for OpenCodeGo windows, DeepSeek balance, OpenRouter credits, SiliconFlow and Moonshot balances — auto-detects DSH credentials, host-side fetching (keys never reach the browser), custom providers via ~/.dsh/dsh-quota-hub.json.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一个可折叠的玻璃面板，实时汇总显示所有主流模型服务的余额和配额，让你一眼看清所有账户状态。

plugins.name: SunshineR04/dsh-session-manager
plugins.description: Restore archived sessions or permanently delete session files from Settings and the session menu. Deletion has no backup; the UI asks for confirmation, agent tools require an explicit confirm flag, and running sessions are refused by default.
plugins.descriptionZh: 管理已归档的会话，支持一键恢复或彻底删除，让历史记录井井有条。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-meter
plugins.description: Usage tiers (🐟→🐳) with a locally-estimated percentile and shareable stats card; 46 models across 6 vendors including size-tiered Chinese pricing; backfills pre-install sessions; old-vs-new rates across the 2026-08-17 change.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上电表，实时查看 token 用量和费用，支持人民币账单和错峰半价计价，还能生成分享卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-session-handoff
plugins.description: Hand long sessions over to a clean one: /handoff summarizes the conversation with an LLM, creates a new session+agent in the same workspace, injects the handoff document as the first message, and auto-opens it; the origin session stays unchanged.
plugins.descriptionZh: 长对话太乱？一键把当前会话总结成文档，开个新会话接着聊，上下文不丢。

commands: npm install && npm run build && npm pack

plugins.name: dsh-history
plugins.description: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and click-to-jump that auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在超长会话里快速查看、搜索并跳转你发过的所有消息，一键复制，轻松找回被折叠的历史。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-crystal
plugins.description: Floating cost crystal for the DSH Web UI: balance card, real-time tok/s, peak/off-peak billing countdown, last-24h spend, and a 🔮 next-message cost forecast, all timezone-aware.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页界面悬浮显示余额、实时速率和费用预测，帮你随时掌握花销。

plugins.name: dsh-session-repair-ui
plugins.description: Session repair button in the conversation header: detects & fixes session-log corruption — tool-call id swaps, empty call ids (`message must have tool source`), unknown event types from disabled plugins (marks `ignorable`), torn zstd tails, missing final-frame newlines; ghost-style UI, auto-backup before writes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 会话头部一键修复日志损坏，解决会话加载失败、发不出消息的问题。

plugins.name: dsh-capability-panel
plugins.description: See which skills and tools your agent can actually reach right now — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一眼看清智能体当前真正能用哪些技能和工具，加载、截断、被挤掉的状态都实时可见。

plugins.name: dsh-event-auditor
plugins.description: Event-flow audit panel: event types, distribution, counts, and recent events for plugin authors.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为插件作者打造的事件流审计面板，直观展示事件类型、分布、计数和最近事件，帮你快速搞懂 DSH 内部动态。

plugins.name: dsh-file-upload
plugins.description: One upload button plus drag-and-drop files into the conversation as local paths: save to the project's uploads/, path text into the input box, works with any vision tool.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键上传或拖拽文件到对话，自动保存到项目目录并填入本地路径，方便配合视觉工具使用。

plugins.name: dsh-session-explorer
plugins.description: Message-level full-text search browser across DSH sessions (FTS5 trigram over user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message and one-click jump to the real session, incremental/full rebuild with health check, zh/en i18n follows the Host locale.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在会话里按消息级别全文搜索，快速定位任意一条用户、助手或工具消息，还能预览上下文并一键跳转原会话。

plugins.name: dsh-billing-tui
plugins.description: Real-time token/cost billing with official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing: TUI status line and a whale ASCII receipt via /billing.
plugins.descriptionZh: 实时统计 DeepSeek 用量和花费，按官方峰谷价计费，状态栏随时看，输入 /billing 还能打印鲸鱼小票。

plugins.name: dsh-bill
plugins.description: Cost tracking: per-turn cost line, spend attributed to tool output / model output / system prompt / commands, budget, forecast; priced per call from models.dev + OpenRouter (8000+ models) and never recomputed.
plugins.descriptionZh: 实时显示每次对话花费，并按内容类型生成成本归因报告，帮你搞清楚钱都花在哪了。

plugins.name: dsh-maze
plugins.description: Execution maze for agent sessions: main path, detours and backtracks on one timeline, per-step data tracks (tools, tokens, context pressure), deterministic analysis (outcome evidence, behavior signals) and multi-session comparison.
plugins.descriptionZh: 像看迷宫一样看清 Agent 每一步怎么干活，对比多次执行，定位问题更轻松。

plugins.name: runcat-tommy/dsh-panda-calendar
plugins.description: Panda Calendar (熊猫日历) conversation-view tab: solar/lunar dates, ganzhi, Chinese zodiac, solar terms, festivals, China public holidays incl. make-up workdays, multi-city weather, an epoch↔date timestamp converter with a time-zone picker, and bundled offline "on this day" history; free data sources, no API key.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在对话里直接看农历、干支、节气、节假日和调休，还能查多城市天气。

plugins.name: woosh2010/dsh-usage-dashboard
plugins.description: Peak/valley billing dock and usage analytics: token/cost/model stats, trend and token-mix charts, latest-20-turns records, global time/session/model filters.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek 用量和花费做成可视化面板，峰谷计费、趋势图表、最近 20 轮记录一目了然。

plugins.name: dsh-session-enhance
plugins.description: Full-control session management for DSH Web: archive, guaranteed physical delete (tombstone anti-resurrection), drag-and-drop workspace moves, conversation notifications, copy session ID and one-click record sync.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端实现会话全掌控，支持归档、彻底删除及跨工作区拖拽，操作真实文件，侧边栏实时同步。

plugins.name: DeepSeekGUI
plugins.description: Windows desktop workbench with a bundled DSH runtime and app-local settings and sessions, Changes / Git / Worktrees / Memory views, approval-gated Git/PR tools, and global and project memory. Experimental Linux AppImage.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 套个图形界面，像用桌面软件一样操作智能体，不用敲命令。

plugins.name: Minke
plugins.description: Desktop agent workspace for DeepSeek Harness on macOS, Windows, and Linux, with shared browser control, integrated files and terminals, remote access, and local model management.
plugins.descriptionZh: Minke 是 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面工作区，让你在本地原生环境中轻松管理智能体、模型与任务，提升操作效率。

plugins.name: PaperMachine
plugins.description: Desktop data-analysis app built on DeepSeek Harness, running local Python and R with inspectable execution steps and chart/table provenance.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在本地跑 Python 和 R 做数据分析，每张图表都能追溯到背后的代码，结果可信可复现。

plugins.name: wjingshan/dsh-cost-gauge
plugins.description: Peak/off-peak billing cost dial for the DSH Web GUI: session spend and account balance computed at the official rates, a low-balance alarm, drag-to-resize and a minimized status-lamp mode.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 dsh 界面挂个浮动小窗，实时看 DeepSeek 花了多少钱、还剩多少，余额不足自动闪红灯。

plugins.name: dsh-grok-tui
plugins.description: Use dsh via grok-build's tui.
