plugins.descriptionZh: 把 grok 的终端界面接到 dsh 上，让你用熟悉的 TUI 操作 DeepSeek Harness，提示词、工具和会话管理都交给 dsh 处理。

plugins.name: olimc2016/dsh-token-meter-panel
plugins.description: Sidebar panel for token usage and cost: today's spend, budget progress, 7/30-day trends, cost breakdown, cache-hit savings, and per-session breakdown.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在侧栏实时查看今天花了多少钱、钱花在哪、缓存省了多少，还能盯预算和余额。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-dashboard
plugins.description: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working hours and quality metrics; gridstack+ECharts cards are drag-and-drop composable, with custom formulas and AI arrangement (prompt round-trip import).
plugins.descriptionZh: 离线扫描会话日志，把用量数据做成可自由编排的可视化仪表盘，随时掌握使用情况。

plugins.name: Harness Desktop
plugins.description: Windows desktop app for the official DSH Web UI with a Chinese installer and portable build, quick themes, an in-app plugin marketplace, separate main/subagent model selection, and verified updates.
plugins.descriptionZh: Windows 桌面客户端，内置中文安装包和便携版，支持主题切换、插件市场、主副模型分开选，更新验证更安心。

plugins.name: plugin-session-export
plugins.description: Exports append-only session logs as Markdown or HTML.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把追加式的会话日志导出为 Markdown 或 HTML，方便保存、分享和二次编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-terminal
plugins.description: Collapsible in-conversation interactive terminal with multi-tab live shells, auto-reconnect, one-click quick commands, and a bilingual UI that follows the theme.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在对话里直接开一个可折叠的多标签终端，随时跑命令、看结果，还能自动重连和快速执行常用指令。

plugins.name: dsh-pi-tui
plugins.description: Pi TUI (differential-rendering terminal framework) front end: streaming markdown, thinking collapse, tool cards, slash commands, approval/question overlays, shared dsh session store.
plugins.descriptionZh: 用 pi 的观感在终端里聊 DeepSeek：流式 Markdown、思考折叠、工具卡片、斜杠命令，还能弹窗确认，会话自动保存。

plugins.name: lk251066/dsh-tui-pro
plugins.description: Full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 搬进全屏终端，多会话管理项目，思考、工具、差异、计划一眼看清。

plugins.name: dsh desktop
plugins.description: Community Tauri 2 desktop wrapper for the DSH Web UI on Windows, macOS and Linux; scan a QR code to access the computer's dsh from a phone over LAN, Tailscale or Cloudflare, sharing sessions and config with the CLI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 dsh web 装进原生窗口，跨平台桌面客户端，会话数据与命令行完全同步。

plugins.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
plugins.description: Self-contained macOS/Windows desktop host for the official DSH Web UI; macOS uses Tauri/WKWebView and ships sub-90 MB DMGs with the Harness runtime bundled.
plugins.descriptionZh: 轻量级 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端，macOS 安装包不到 90MB，跨平台运行，让你在本地快速使用 AI 编程助手。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop
plugins.description: Download-and-run Electron desktop build (macOS/Windows installers): no Node.js or terminal needed, tracks upstream `@deepseek-ai/dsh` releases automatically, with built-in web UI and auto-update.
plugins.descriptionZh: 下载安装就能用的 DeepSeek 桌面客户端，不用装 Node.js 和终端，填个 API Key 就能让 AI 帮你干活。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-desktop
plugins.description: Native Windows desktop shell: 1:1 official web UI with embedded server hosting, tray and auto-recovery.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 官方网页界面装进 Windows 桌面，内置本地服务、托盘常驻还能自动恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-open-editor
plugins.description: Open the current workspace in your local editor (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains, Vim, ...) from the session header.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 会话页一键用 VS Code 等编辑器打开当前项目目录，支持切换 Cursor、Windsurf 等，省去手动找路径的麻烦。

plugins.name: dsh-open-with
plugins.description: Open registered DSH workspaces from the Web UI in detected or configured local editors, terminals, or file managers, with a remembered per-browser preference.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在网页端一键打开已注册的 DSH 工作区，自动调用本地编辑器、终端或文件管理器，并记住你的偏好。

plugins.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
plugins.description: One-click Tauri 2 desktop distribution of DeepSeek Harness: bundled runtime, no Node.js/pnpm/Docker required, native macOS/Windows/Linux packages.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 打包成开箱即用的桌面应用，不用装 Node.js 或 Docker，双击就能跑。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/browser-automation
plugins.description: Web Bridge: browser automation MCP server for dsh — real-browser navigation, click, form-fill, screenshots, JS execution, accessibility-tree snapshot driven.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让智能体操控真实浏览器，自动打开网页、点击、填表、截图、执行JS，还能读取无障碍树来理解页面。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/computer-control
plugins.description: Desktop control for dsh: screen capture, pointer/keyboard injection, accessibility-tree semantic actions, emergency stop, allow/deny rules, confirmation flow and idle standby.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让智能体直接操控电脑桌面，支持截图观察、模拟鼠标键盘、无障碍树语义操作，并带紧急停止和权限管控。

plugins.name: mrRisega/dsh-remote
plugins.description: Reverse-proxy gateway to control the DSH Web UI from a phone browser with full feature coverage (incl. privileged methods): loopback masquerading, WebSocket passthrough, login rate limiting, optional TLS, LAN or public reverse-proxy deployment.
plugins.descriptionZh: 用手机浏览器远程操控 DSH 网页界面，功能全开，像 App 一样顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-builtin-browser
plugins.description: Shared real browser for DSH: a visible browser window the human can take over, driven by the agent over CDP (snapshot/execute/content/tab management).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供共享真实浏览器，用户可见可接管，agent 通过 CDP 驱动操作网页。

plugins.name: xgone/dsh-netshell
plugins.description: Local and remote SSH terminals for DeepSeek Harness Web, with three permission levels, rule-based command confirmation, and DSH credential storage. Guards cover commands sent through this plugin and do not provide a security sandbox.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 Web 界面直接开 SSH 远程终端，危险命令有三级护栏，AI 提的命令必须真人确认，密码加密存储不泄露给 AI。

plugins.name: xgone/dsh-remote
plugins.description: Remote access & authentication for DeepSeek Harness web UI: account/password login gate, MFA (TOTP), signed session cookies, role-based access, in-browser directory picker, and a Settings page for account management (npm: @xgone/dsh-remote).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加上账号密码登录、MFA 验证和权限管理，远程访问更安全。

plugins.name: dsh-remote
plugins.description: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder / path browse), mirror a remote workspace to a real local folder, and operate it with rw_* tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 通过 SSH 连接远程主机，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操作远端工作目录，支持列目录、读写文件和执行命令。

plugins.name: dsh-browser
plugins.description: Chrome sidebar extension.
plugins.descriptionZh: Chrome 侧边栏插件，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控你的浏览器，无需视觉能力也能自动完成网页操作。

riskyReasons: 含远程脚本下载执行（curl/wget 管道 shell）

plugins.name: dsh-ssh
plugins.description: AI-managed SSH connections with a live multi-tab terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理 SSH 连接，带多标签实时终端面板，操作更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-dispatch
plugins.description: Phone-side command center (plugin + zero-knowledge relay + PWA): dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from your phone, approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins (never auto-approved), and a multi-machine session board; E2E encrypted, self-hostable.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在手机上给 DeepSeek Harness 派任务、一键审批工具调用，远程指挥每台机器干活。

plugins.name: dsh-browser-runtime
plugins.description: Self-contained browser runtime plugin: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local deps (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and interactive browser tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让模型能打开网页、读内容、点页面、截图和下载文件，自带浏览器运行时，装好就能用。

plugins.name: dsh-lan-access
plugins.description: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts (npm: dsh-lan-access).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 网页界面绑定局域网，手机平板直接浏览器访问，不用 SSH 也不用内网穿透。

plugins.name: dsh-computer-use
plugins.description: Text-first computer use: background Chromium control via Playwright/CDP plus accessibility-first macOS control; actions stay pinned to the correct process and window without taking the user's pointer (Developer ID signed, notarized Universal 2 DMG).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 AI 用文字指令操控浏览器和 macOS 应用，后台运行不抢你的鼠标。

plugins.name: dsh-click
plugins.description: Native desktop control for DeepSeek Harness (Windows first): screen_shot, screen_read accessibility trees, click/type/scroll/key, and app launch — approval-gated, never stealing foreground focus.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 AI 直接操控 Windows 桌面：截图、读界面、点击输入滚动、启动应用，每步都需授权且不抢焦点。

plugins.name: dsh-antigravity
plugins.description: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider for DSH with native Web OAuth, real-time quota tracking, and dynamic reasoning effort routing.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 接入 Google Antigravity 模型，支持网页授权登录、实时配额查看和智能推理强度路由。

plugins.name: dsh-tabbit
plugins.description: Drive the user's Tabbit Browser from DSH via its Browser-owned, task-isolated Playwright CLI (`tabbit-cli`): bundled `tabbit-browser` skill, ≥1.9.0 runtime preflight, region-aware installer download, and persistent named task spaces (no Chrome/Ego/CDP fallback).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 里直接操控 Tabbit 浏览器，自动完成网页操作任务。

plugins.name: ego-browser
plugins.description: Browser agent.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 AI 直接操控浏览器，自动打开网页、点击和填表，还能看到它的每一步操作。

plugins.name: dsh-adb
plugins.description: ADB device and bench operations for DeepSeek Harness, including logcat, APK, file, and performance tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 通过 ADB 管理 Android 设备与车机台架，支持设备发现、日志流式抓取、安装应用、文件传输和性能快照，方便联调与测试。

plugins.name: dsh-webbridge
plugins.description: Web bridge.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让模型直接操控你真实的浏览器，网页操作、填表、抓取都能自动搞定。

plugins.name: sheep-programmer/dsh-web-search-free
plugins.description: Free web search for DSH: anonymous Parallel default plus Exa fallback, a Settings toggle, and an MCP server compatible with Claude Code and Codex.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 加个免费联网搜索，匿名可用、Exa 兜底，还能当 MCP 服务给 Claude Code 和 Codex 用。

plugins.name: SeerableOfficial/dsh-web-search-toggle
plugins.description: Per-session Web Search toggle that directs the agent to search the web before answering.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在聊天输入框加个「联网搜索」开关，打开后助手会先搜网页再回答。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/model-catalog
plugins.description: Model catalog auto-discovery: fetch model listings, pricing and capabilities from OpenAI-compatible API hosts, normalized into ready-to-use config.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动发现 OpenAI 兼容接口的模型列表、价格和能力，一键生成可直接使用的配置。

plugins.name: dsh-browser-vision
plugins.description: Vision browser tool: drives real Chrome over CDP with browser-use and reads the page with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, so canvas text, text baked into images and values in rendered charts are readable; returns JSON validated against a caller-supplied schema and reports per-run token cost.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让浏览器工具能看懂网页内容，直接读取截图、图表和图片里的文字，无需额外解析。

plugins.name: dsh-zcode-cli-proxy
plugins.description: ZCode CLI app-server relay for DeepSeek Harness, with GLM streaming, image input and session reuse using an existing Start Plan login; requires the ZCode client.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 的模型请求转给 ZCode 客户端执行，复用 Start Plan 登录，支持 GLM 流式输出和图片输入。

plugins.name: dsh-zcode-coding-plan
plugins.description: Dispatches coding tasks to the official ZCode CLI, with native agent tools, multi-turn resume, context caching and quota-aware routing.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 桌面端通过官方 ZCode CLI 派发 GLM Coding Plan 任务，按额度自动选路，省积分又省心。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-computer-use
plugins.description: Let a DSH model inspect and operate Windows applications through an installed Codex Computer Use runtime, with per-session app approval.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 模型直接操控 Windows 应用，看窗口、截图、点击输入，按会话授权更安全。

plugins.name: xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast
plugins.description: Drive a real browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks each operation and element, so a DSH session spends one tool call.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 对话里用大白话指挥真实浏览器干活，自动完成网页操作。

plugins.name: dsh-image-gen
plugins.description: Native image generation for DeepSeek Harness with Google Gemini, OpenAI Images, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and ByteDance Seedream.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接生成图片，支持 Gemini、OpenAI 和字节 Seedream 等多种模型，即插即用。

plugins.name: dsh-vertex-gemini
plugins.description: Gemini provider for DeepSeek Harness on Google Cloud Vertex AI, with Application Default Credentials, streaming, and thought-signature replay across tool calls.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 里直接用 Google 账号登录 Vertex AI，免密钥调用 Gemini 模型。

plugins.name: dsh-mini-remote
plugins.description: Mobile web remote for a DSH session: three view modes (latest conclusion / chat / full trace with diffs), LAN, Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel routes with per-route QR pairing, instruction queueing and approval or question cards on the phone, plus a Feishu long-connection channel.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 搬到手机上，单帧、聊天、完整三种模式随心切换，只看你想看的内容。

plugins.name: dsh-agy-link
plugins.description: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) model provider for DSH: stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Google Antigravity 模型接入 DSH，支持流式对话、思考过程、工具调用和用量统计，还能在界面里直接登录 Google 账号。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agy-link@latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org

plugins.name: dsh-llm-compat-healer
plugins.description: LLM compatibility auto-healer for transit/gateway providers: repairs DeepSeek `reasoning_content` replay and unsupported `developer` roles without a restart, exposes pi-ai compatibility settings, and adds redacted Chinese summaries for upstream errors.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动修复中转网关的模型兼容问题，不用重启就能让请求正常跑通。

plugins.name: dsh-baseurl-probe
plugins.description: Provider baseURL auto-detection: when a provider's baseURL is a bare domain (e.g. `https://mzeapi.top`) and only `/v1` serves the OpenAI-compatible API, the plugin auto-fixes it — probes all providers with zero-cost path detection (no API key needed).
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动探测并补全供应商 baseURL 的 /v1 路径，免去手动改配置的麻烦，让 AI 接口无缝连通。

plugins.name: dsh-provider-health
plugins.description: Provider health dashboard as a Settings page: read-only per-provider status, health (time-decayed from recent errors), thinking capability, max tokens and latest error, sourced from the llm-pi-ai config and the compat-healer error log.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置页一眼看清各 Provider 的连接状态、健康度、Thinking 能力和最近报错，方便排查问题。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-oauth
plugins.description: ChatGPT/Codex subscription integration for DSH with GPT models, image generation, web search, quota reporting, and browser/device-code OAuth sign-in.
plugins.descriptionZh: 用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅登录，在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接调用 GPT 模型、画图、联网搜索。

plugins.name: exoticknight/dsh-labnana
plugins.description: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing (NanoBanana Pro, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, GPT-Image-2, Wan2.7, Seedream).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接生成和编辑图片，支持文生图、图生图和精准修改，用 API 密钥即可。

plugins.name: ysr666/dsh-vision-router
plugins.description: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image and it just works — no Python, one-command install.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给纯文本AI装上眼睛：免密钥看图问答、抠图、截图、OCR、颜色识别等，粘贴图片就能用。

plugins.name: dsh-serverchan-notify
plugins.description: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes: title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt; subagent filtering, fire-and-forget, key from env/config/file.
plugins.descriptionZh: 回合结束时通过ServerChan3推送通知，包含模型、项目目录、git分支、状态和回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，即发即忘。

plugins.name: dsh-draw
plugins.description: Unified static-image generation router: one image_generate tool with standard parameters, config-driven OpenAI-compatible engine routing (OpenAI Images, Zhipu CogView, and any compatible endpoint) with health-aware fallback, durable workspace attachment results, per-session quota accounting, an in-conversation result card, and a Plugins settings panel that stores API keys as credential references.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一个工具统一调用多家绘图模型，配置好引擎就能按需生成图片，不用来回切换接口。

plugins.name: welsione/dsh-model-router
plugins.description: Unified model routing: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一个逻辑模型ID聚合多家供应商，自动按用途选档，故障时秒切备用模型，省钱又省心。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-subscription
plugins.description: ChatGPT OAuth provider for DSH with Codex models, image generation, selectable subscription search, standard and Spark quota reporting, and a native settings page.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，直接登录使用 Codex 模型、生成图片，还能查看配额和用量。

plugins.name: dsh-clawrouter
plugins.description: Blocking safety gate: a stronger model rules allow/deny/ask on risky tool calls, enforced by the tool executor rather than by prompt. Optional BlockRun x402 route for 67 models, paid per request from a wallet.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体加个“第二大脑”，高风险工具调用前让更强模型把关，一个钱包还能用 70 个模型。

plugins.name: DSH-Multimodal
plugins.description: Per-file-type multimodal chains: preset processing models per wildcard convert image/video/audio files into prompt tokens before they reach the text-only session model, with per-preset fallback chains and a Multimodal settings page.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让只认文字的会话模型也能看懂图片、视频和音频，按文件类型配置处理模型链，先转成文本再进会话。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add <本插件路径或 tgz>
dsh plugin --profile headless add <本插件路径或 tgz>

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-vision
plugins.description: Vision for text-only LLMs: image description / OCR / VQA via free Gemini and GLM vision APIs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给纯文本大模型装上眼睛，用免费 Gemini / GLM 接口看图、识别文字、回答图像问题。

plugins.name: dsh-vision
plugins.description: Vision bridge: view_image tool over any OpenAI-compatible VLM (Zhipu free tier by default).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给纯文本的 DeepSeek 加上眼睛，通过 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型实现看图、OCR、读图表等能力。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-acp
plugins.description: An ACP profile plugin and standalone server that exposes the full DSH agent to Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的能力开放给 Zed 等 ACP 客户端，共享登录状态和会话，让你在编辑器里直接用上完整 DSH 智能体。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-proxy
plugins.description: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: GUI images are transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images); any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 也能看图：发图自动转成文字描述，对话大脑不用换。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-subagent-director
plugins.description: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates (subagent_role tool).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给每个子代理单独指定 LLM 供应商和模型，还能用角色模板安排主代理和子代理的分工。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-mcp-server
plugins.description: Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server, letting any MCP client (e.g. Hermes) drive Harness to execute coding tasks.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的编码能力封装成 MCP 服务，让 Hermes 等任意 MCP 客户端直接调用它干活。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-acn
plugins.description: Join ACN from DeepSeek Harness: register this agent, discover others, send messages, read the inbox. Defaults to the China region.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让你的 AI Agent 加入 ACN 网络，自动发现其他智能体并互发消息，默认直连国内节点。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-tools
plugins.description: Per-call model / provider / persona / toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, @preset: references, provider/model composite ids (bundle, no patched files).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为子代理调用提供按次覆盖模型、供应商、角色和工具过滤，支持 @preset 引用与复合 ID，无需修改文件即可灵活委派。

plugins.name: dsh-a2a
plugins.description: Agent2Agent mesh.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让多个AI代理实时互联互通，组成协作网络，高效完成任务。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-cwd
plugins.description: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents and the two in-process provider patches it requires.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给子代理增加每次调用的独立工作目录，并附带所需的内进程补丁，让子代理任务更灵活可控。

plugins.name: dsh-slice-agent-loop
plugins.description: Drop-in agent loop with bounded-slice context engine (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为智能体循环提供精准上下文切片，每次只给模型所需信息，提升效率与准确性。

plugins.name: penguin-oo/dsh-delegate-router
plugins.description: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动给子代理分配模型，简单的跑便宜版，复杂的留强模型，帮你省算力又不掉链子。

plugins.name: Cavan-Ou/dsh-flash-godmode
plugins.description: Reasoning-mode routing plugin for V4 Flash on headless: w7 persona anchoring, first-turn tool anchoring and complexity-dispatched guidance.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 V4 Flash 在无头环境下稳定输出，通过角色锚定和工具引导，把不稳定的推理变成可复现的能力。

plugins.name: dsh-subscription-auth
plugins.description: Subscription OAuth login: use ChatGPT/Claude/Grok/Kimi subscription accounts (not API keys) with automatic model discovery.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 dsh 直接用 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、Kimi 的订阅账号登录，不用再配 API key，还能自动发现可用模型。

plugins.name: dsh-advisor
plugins.description: Second model passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 搭配一个副模型，在每轮对话中被动审查内容并注入见解，帮你发现盲点、优化回答。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-oauth
plugins.description: OAuth / subscription-plan LLM login (Grok, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Anthropic, OpenRouter): durable credential store with on-request token refresh, no repo patches (Grok/Copilot verified; use Codex with caution).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入订阅制 LLM 服务，支持 Grok、GitHub Copilot、OpenAI Codex 等，用 OAuth 登录即可调用。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-fallbacks
plugins.description: Role-based LLM retry/fallback strategy.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 LLM 调用配置基于角色的重试与备用策略，提升模型服务的稳定性与可靠性。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-local-token
plugins.description: Reuse the OAuth credentials your local Codex CLI and Claude Code already hold: registers `openai-codex` and `anthropic` routes read from `~/.codex/auth.json` and `~/.claude/.credentials.json` (macOS Keychain fallback), refreshes tokens near expiry, and reports subscription usage from provider rate-limit headers.
plugins.descriptionZh: 复用本地 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 的 OAuth 登录态，免去 API Key，直接作为模型路由调用 LLM。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-fallback
plugins.description: Provider fallback chain: the request head is never rewritten (your picked model stays); on switchable failure it retries through the configured backup targets in order, with a Web UI settings panel.
plugins.descriptionZh: 主模型挂了也不怕，自动按顺序切到备用模型重试，对话不再中断。

plugins.name: loongport-dsh
plugins.description: Multi-site relay provider setup: signed provider directory (identity, URLs, models), Settings → LoongPort page for provider and manual API key configuration, OpenAI-compatible routes (npm: loongport).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LoongPort 兼容的 OpenAI 接口配置工具，支持自定义端点，方便快速接入。

plugins.name: dsh-output-styles
plugins.description: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity (/style command, per-session persistence, web picker), plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a renderer registry, per-session/per-tool rules, and /export.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可切换的输出样式，支持 /style 命令、会话级持久化及 Web 选择器，并扩展了渲染器注册协议。

plugins.name: dsh-github
plugins.description: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: composite action.yml, polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 GitHub 接入 DeepSeek Harness，后台创建和审查 PR、读取 issue，所有写入操作都需人工确认，安全又省心。

plugins.name: rapid-mlx-dsh-provider
plugins.description: Native provider for Rapid-MLX, an Apple-silicon local inference server: registers a `rapid-mlx` LlmAdapter route that reads model facts (context window, reasoning parser, capabilities) from the server's `/v1/models` instead of a hand-written settings.yaml, so switching served models needs no re-setup and compaction is timed to the real context window.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接从 Rapid-MLX 服务器读取模型信息，无需手动配置，开箱即用。

plugins.name: dsh-local-ai
plugins.description: Ollama local-model adapter: ollama_list/pull/remove/show plus health checks, registers an Ollama route via the official LlmAdapter with model_route rules (offline-first / long-text / privacy) and cloud fallback; /ollama command for a one-shot overview.
plugins.descriptionZh: 接入 Ollama 本地模型，支持模型管理、健康检查与路由规则，实现离线优先、长文本和隐私保护的智能调用。

plugins.name: dsh-sampling-sliders
plugins.description: Composer sampling panel: temperature / maxTokens sliders with hot-apply and persist-to-file modes, applied to every provider via the agent/request hook.
plugins.descriptionZh: 输入栏一键调出采样面板，用滑杆微调 temperature 和 maxTokens，对所有模型即时生效。

plugins.name: dsh-smart-route
plugins.description: Smart provider routing: composer-button one-click enable/disable, any channel error (including 4xx) auto-falls-back to the next channel, chain names shown in the model selector without exposing internal channels/models, multi-chain management with settings UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 智能供应商路由插件，任何渠道报错自动切换下一家，一键停用启用，模型选择器直接显示链路名称。

plugins.name: dsh-service-control
plugins.description: Restart & shutdown buttons in the session header utilities: graceful appExit shutdown, auto-restart of `dsh web` via scheduled task → launcher `-ControlledRestart`.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在会话头部直接重启或关闭 dsh web 服务，不用切回终端，重启后页面自动重连。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-inspector
plugins.description: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.
plugins.descriptionZh: 统一检查 LLM 请求与响应，支持推理控制、思考导出、流量分析和会话审计，调试更省心。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-ollama
plugins.description: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: registers an `ollama-cloud` LLM route with native model discovery (context windows, vision, thinking, tools) and web search/fetch providers.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Ollama 云模型，自动识别模型能力，支持联网搜索与工具调用。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/worktree-mgr
plugins.description: Task-isolated Git worktrees for dsh: auto-create, sync and tear down isolated workspaces per task.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为每个任务自动创建、同步和清理独立的 git 工作区，让多任务互不干扰，提升开发效率。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-gate
plugins.description: Per-provider concurrency gate on the llm/stream waterfall: holds surplus model requests in a FIFO queue inside DSH so main agent, subagents and compaction take turns on a single-slot local server (llama.cpp --parallel 1) instead of timing out; maxConcurrent / maxQueued / queueTimeoutMs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给每个模型供应商设置并发闸门，让主智能体、子智能体和压缩任务排队轮流使用本地单槽服务器，避免请求过载。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/spec-driven
plugins.description: Keel (龙骨): spec-driven development discipline skill pack — spec-first, verify assumptions, prevent over-engineering and scope creep; skills+tools+templates for dsh.
plugins.descriptionZh: 先写规格再写代码，帮你验证假设、防止过度设计和范围蔓延，让开发不跑偏。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-rollout-scout
plugins.description: Detects which conversation model your account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds.
plugins.descriptionZh: 并发发起临时探测对话，通过分析思维链开头判断你的账号正被分配到哪个模型。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/adversarial-review
plugins.description: Gavel-review: adversarial multi-perspective code review — parallel attack lenses, deterministic static sentinels, cross-lens merge/dedup, severity grading, suppression rules and review history; dsh tools + standalone CLI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 用多视角对抗式审查代码，自动合并去重并分级严重性，支持规则过滤和历史追溯，提升代码审查深度与效率。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-doctor
plugins.description: Explains which layer killed a failed turn: times every model request (first byte, longest silence, total) and combines that with the error to name the culprit (dsh idle watchdog vs Node undici timers vs SDK timer vs server crash, context overflow, gate queue, tool timeouts, failed compactions) and the exact setting to change; verdicts in the DSH terminal plus a /why command, subagents included.
plugins.descriptionZh: 诊断 DeepSeek Harness 中回合失败的原因，精准定位是哪个超时或设置导致的。

plugins.name: openllmsh/dsh
plugins.description: Routes the harness through the OpenLLM gateway: a pure-config Cordis patch that adds an `openllm` provider to the in-box pi-ai adapter pointed at the local daemon (`127.0.0.1:8787/v1`, no API key held by dsh) and registers the `openllm mcp` stdio server (openllm, claude-context, supermemory tool groups).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 Harness 接上本地 OpenLLM 网关，无需 API Key 就能直接调用模型。

plugins.name: dsh-logbook
plugins.description: Makes ctx.logger output visible: a /logs chat command over a full-capture ring (level, name, grep, since filters) plus a default-on stderr exporter for warnings and errors, configurable per plugin; works headless. Also documents that dsh's default log buffer silently drops warn and debug records.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 ctx.logger 的日志在聊天里可见，通过 /logs 命令查看过滤，还能把警告和错误输出到 stderr，方便调试。

plugins.name: dsh-fetch-timeouts
plugins.description: Raises Node's HTTP headers/body timeouts for the whole DSH process (default 30 min, proxy-aware) so Ollama and LM Studio models that stay silent while thinking or generating a large tool call are not cut off at 5 minutes; replaces the node_modules undici patch.
plugins.descriptionZh: 全局调高 Node 的 HTTP 超时时间，避免慢速本地模型（如 Ollama、LM Studio）因静默超 5 分钟被中断。

plugins.name: dsh-model-pin
plugins.description: Keeps every model request inside a per-provider allow-list, enforced at the agent/request waterfall: disallowed models are redirected to a fallback or refused; subagents stop inheriting stale creation-time routes; warns when consecutive requests would make a --models-max 1 llama.cpp router reload models. A one-entry list is a global single-model mode.
plugins.descriptionZh: 按供应商锁定可用模型，超出白名单的请求自动降级或拒绝，防止子智能体乱用模型。

plugins.name: dsh-think-ultra
plugins.description: Pins every request to native `max` reasoning effort instead of the `ultra` option, with isolated Flash / Pro / Vision depth presets. Distributed as a build-only artifact: the core is closed and its license forbids reverse-engineering, deobfuscation and repackaging.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加一层深度推理控制，让每次请求都保持最高思考强度，还能单独调节不同模型模式的深度。

plugins.name: lynkr-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Registers Lynkr, a self-hosted tier-routing LLM gateway, as a custom OpenAI-compatible provider: classifies each request's difficulty and routes it to the cheapest model that can handle it, across 15+ providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure, Bedrock, Vertex, OpenRouter, Ollama, DeepSeek, and more).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Lynkr 接入 DeepSeek Harness，自动按请求难度路由到最便宜的可用模型，省钱又省心。

plugins.name: Zn-Dk/dsh-zhipu-toolkit
plugins.description: Dual-endpoint Zhipu BigModel GLM provider catalog (Coding Plan + ordinary API) with live model discovery, live-tested thinking-tier mapping, and a settings card for keys, endpoints, the default reasoning tier, and local API key support (key stored in the DSH credential store).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入智谱 GLM 模型，支持双端点模型目录、思考模式映射和在线模型发现，即装即用。

plugins.name: du-yuxuan/OneKey-Models
plugins.description: TokenDance gateway integration with OAuth PKCE sign-in, DSH credential-store support, live model discovery, per-model visibility, image generation and multimodal input.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键接入 TokenDance 全部 108 个模型，在 DSH 里直接调用，省去逐个配置的麻烦。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-custom
plugins.description: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent's own request is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that label maps to; per-session inherit/auto/manual selection, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and a ledger of recent dispatches.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给子代理挑模型、分任务，按需智能分流，省心又省钱。

plugins.name: dsh-oh-my-claude
plugins.description: Claude Code CLI as a model provider for DSH: runs the logged-in CLI over stream-json at subscription price, with the live model list, per-session resume, permission prompts relayed into the access shield, images, an MCP bridge to dsh tools, and workspaces on remote SSH boxes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Claude Code 接进 dsh 当模型用，支持会话续接、图片、审批转发和远程 SSH 工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-ci-co-pilot
plugins.description: GitHub workflow plugin for PR review, CI failure diagnosis and fixes, issue triage, and release-note drafting.
plugins.descriptionZh: 帮你自动审 PR、查 CI 报错并修、整理 issue、起草发布说明的 GitHub 工作流助手。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-verifier
plugins.description: Runs 3 or 5 coding-agent candidates in detached Git worktrees, validates their patches with project commands, ranks only passing candidates, and requires separate approval before applying the winner.
plugins.descriptionZh: 并行跑多个AI编程助手，自动验证补丁并让LLM打分排名，通过后才应用最佳方案。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/dsh-repo-setup
plugins.description: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files (claude-code-setup counterpart).
plugins.descriptionZh: 只读扫描仓库，摸清技术栈、测试、文档、Git 和数据库情况，并推荐该装的插件、MCP 服务和规范文件。

plugins.name: dsh-bash-rtk
plugins.description: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) inside the DSH bash executor to compress tool output and save tokens; safe passthrough when rtk is absent.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把符合条件的 bash 命令交给 rtk 压缩输出，省下 token；没装 rtk 也能安全直通。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-github
plugins.description: GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding, and one-click workspace integration.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接查仓库、搜代码、管 Issue 和 PR，还能绑定 GitHub 账号，一键接入工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-git-identity
plugins.description: Pin Git commit authorship to the environment identity (gh account + noreply email).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 环境里的所有 Git 提交自动使用当前 GitHub 账号身份，省去手动配置作者信息的麻烦。

plugins.name: dsh-atomgit
plugins.description: AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: atomgit-skills workflows (plan/implement/review/merge issues & PRs), ag CLI, and platform-hosted GitCode MCP tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 AtomGit 上托管和管理代码，内置 plan/implement/review/merge 工作流、ag 命令行和 GitCode MCP 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-git
plugins.description: Structured Git tools (status/diff/log/branch/stage/commit/stash/show) with a destructive-command guard.
plugins.descriptionZh: 结构化封装 Git 常用操作，带危险命令保护，让 AI 安全地帮你管理代码版本。

plugins.name: duyanta123/dsh-refactor-insight
plugins.description: Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged runbook (read-only, no auto-rewrite).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把代码里的坏味道变成可执行的优先级重构计划，帮你理清技术债、按序优化代码质量。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pub-review
plugins.description: Publish-readiness review for DSH plugins: official docs freshness check, 30+ static checks with a Ready/Not-Ready verdict, and publish preflight + command guidance.
plugins.descriptionZh: 发布前给 DSH 插件做体检：查官方文档更新、跑 30+ 项静态检查，给出能不能发布的结论和命令引导。

plugins.name: dsh-ops-skill
plugins.description: Read-only DSH runtime reliability kit: versioned redacted state contracts, protected snapshots, review-oriented upgrade diffs, and isolated regression checks; no privileged Docker default. *Folder-based Skill; not a DSH profile bundle.*
plugins.descriptionZh: 只读的 DSH 运行时可靠性工具包，帮你做状态快照、升级差异对比和隔离回归检查，不动 Docker 权限。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-check
plugins.description: Plugin health checks (manifest/patch format/build pitfalls/hub status).
plugins.descriptionZh: 扫描插件仓库，诊断清单协议、patch格式、构建陷阱和hub收录状态，输出合规报告与修复建议，全程只读不修改。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add <npm pack 产物 tarball 路径>

plugins.name: dsh-auto-blame
plugins.description: Auto blame.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动追踪代码改动来源，帮你快速定位每行代码是谁改的、什么时候改的。

plugins.name: hermes-dsh-collab
plugins.description: Hook DeepSeek Harness into a Hermes pipeline: dispatch-spec template, model-tier routing, orchestrator-run quality gates, git single-writer rule, as a SKILL.md pack (bundle installable).
plugins.descriptionZh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Hermes 流水线，自动分发任务、执行并验证，用质量门禁杜绝自报自夸。

plugins.name: dsh-inspect
plugins.description: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop.
plugins.descriptionZh: 对抗式检查闭环插件，帮你发现问题、修复交付、再复查质量。

plugins.name: dsh-verification-receipt
plugins.description: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把每轮工具调用次数和验证信号记成本地 JSONL 摘要，不存提示词和参数，方便事后核查。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-action
plugins.description: GitHub Action that runs DeepSeek Harness for pull request review, CI diagnosis, trusted fixes, and issue-to-PR implementation.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 GitHub 工作流里自动跑 DeepSeek Harness，帮你审 PR、查 CI 故障、修代码、把 issue 直接变成 PR。

plugins.name: dsh-doublecheck
plugins.description: Engineering-discipline loop: requirement grilling before edits, red/green test-evidence gates, adversarial delivery review, and a report with per-dimension verification.
plugins.descriptionZh: 上线前多一道保险：帮你严审需求、验证实现、证明交付，适合追求工程严谨度的团队。

plugins.name: dsh-spur
plugins.description: Task engine.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给任务加把劲，把零散工作串成可追踪的流程，自动推进执行。

plugins.name: dsh-checkpoint-rewind
plugins.description: Claude Code /rewind for DSH: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 加个后悔药：每次工具操作前自动存快照，一条命令就能回滚文件并分叉会话，告别误操作。

plugins.name: dsh-lsp-actions
plugins.description: LSP action surface: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints, and rename tools over real language servers.
plugins.descriptionZh: 接上真实语言服务器，给编辑器补上诊断、格式化、补全、重命名等一整套代码操作能力。

plugins.name: dsh-review-loop
plugins.description: Incremental diff reviewer: checkpoint-based since-review queue with a Web UI panel, /review command, and feedback injection into the agent.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 AI 智能体的代码改动变成增量审查队列，支持网页面板和 /review 命令，还能把反馈直接喂回给智能体。

plugins.name: dsh-test-runner
plugins.description: Structured test runner tool (test_run): auto-detect Vitest/Jest/pytest/node:test, run tests, parse failure summaries for the model.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动识别测试框架并跑测试，只把失败摘要喂给模型，省 token 少绕弯。

plugins.name: Starfie1d1272/dsh-github-skills
plugins.description: Skill-first GitHub workflows for DSH covering PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing over existing capabilities.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 OpenAI Codex 的 GitHub 工作流带到 DeepSeek Harness，搞定 PR 分类、代码审查反馈、Actions 诊断和草稿 PR 发布。

plugins.name: dsh-git-branch-switcher
plugins.description: Session-header Git branch pill: shows the current workspace branch and switches branches from the Web UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在会话头部显示当前 Git 分支，并支持直接从网页界面切换分支，方便多分支协作。

plugins.name: dsh-test-drive
plugins.description: Isolated install-smoke-uninstall test drives for DSH plugins in a throwaway DSH_HOME (install → patch check → launch smoke → uninstall → cleanup), emitting structured dsh-test-drive/v1 results for scoring pipelines.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在隔离的临时环境里自动跑插件的安装、启动冒烟和卸载，验证兼容性并输出结构化报告。

plugins.name: fullstack-expert
plugins.description: Cordis-native, evidence-first engineering workflow layer for coding agents: repository-aware vertical-slice planning (fullstack_plan), explicit pass/fail/unknown evidence checks (fullstack_check), inspect-first methodology, approval-aware sensitive-operation guards, and embedded engineering skills (MIT).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给编程 AI 加上全栈工程流程：先做仓库感知的纵向切片规划，再逐项核验证据，让改动有据可查。

plugins.name: dsh-git-status
plugins.description: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes/stash rows, inline diffs, and right-click branch/tag operations.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在编辑器里直接看 Git 分支和提交图，改了什么、存了什么一目了然，还能右键切分支打标签。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-diff-review
plugins.description: Codex-style diff review in a floating panel: per-round session changes plus a git workspace view with stage/revert/commit/push and a history timeline.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在浮动面板里像 Codex 一样评审代码改动，支持暂存、回滚、提交、推送和历史时间线。

plugins.name: nateEc/dsh-gitLens
plugins.description: Workspace-scoped Git graph with history search and diffs, multi-worktree WIP and agent-session views, and guarded Git operations with recovery refs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里可视化查看 Git 提交图谱、搜索历史与差异，还能安全执行 Git 操作。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks agents from reading/writing sensitive files (.env, credentials), masks leaked secrets in tool results, with an audit journal and safe sg_* inspection tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 拦截智能体对敏感文件（如.env、密钥）的读写，自动打码泄露的机密信息，并记录审计日志，防止数据泄露。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/safety-net
plugins.description: Destructive-command interception gate: parses and requires human approval for rm -rf / git reset --hard / push --force before execution (dsh plugin + standalone CLI).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 AI 助手加一道安全门，执行 rm -rf、强制推送等危险命令前必须人工确认，防止误操作。

plugins.name: dsh-verify
plugins.description: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real Chromium (Firefox/WebKit) verdict out (PASS/FAIL with screenshot receipts). MCP server + CLI + GitHub Action, works with any agent and CI (MIT).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让真实浏览器替 AI 交付的网页做验收，跑一遍就出 PASS/FAIL 和截图凭证。

plugins.name: dsh-repo-context
plugins.description: Injects git status and repo conventions into the system prompt via the official system-prompt seam.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 git 状态和仓库规范自动塞进 system prompt，让模型每次对话都自带上下文，不用手动重复。

plugins.name: duyanta123/arch-doc
plugins.description: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation (module responsibilities, dependency graph, entry points, run methods) via a five-stage runbook plus a zero-dependency arch-profile scanner.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动分析代码库并生成架构文档，帮你理清模块职责、依赖关系和运行方式。

plugins.name: duyanta123/dsh-preset-scaffold
plugins.description: Project-init scaffold preset: strict five-phase runbook, engineering standards, and six runnable starter templates (node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo).
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键生成标准化项目骨架，内置架构师人设和六套模板，帮你从零快速搭好可运行、可验证的工程基础。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-sync
plugins.description: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository - skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话同步起来，自动解决冲突，还能内联 token 走代理，多设备用着不打架。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-pack-security
plugins.description: Security-audit skill pack plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vulnerability intelligence and incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an npm provider bundle that registers the automated plugin_vet pre-install scanner.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 AI 代理装上安全审计技能包，能查密钥泄露、依赖漏洞和供应链风险，还带插件准入把关。

plugins.name: beijingwahw/dsh-nuke-plugin
plugins.description: Transactional uninstall engine: validate/preview/execute/undo per action with Saga rollback, WAL crash recovery, hash-chain audit, hardlink dedup, and a Bayesian oracle that predicts success probability before you commit (MIT).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 插件做彻底卸载：先预览再执行，出错能回滚，崩溃也能恢复，还带审计记录。

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-forge

plugins.descriptionZh: 只读查看 Gitea 和 Forgejo 仓库的版本、议题、PR 差异与 Actions 日志，方便随时掌握项目动态。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-git-server
plugins.description: Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki — reusing user-management credentials, start/stop from the settings page.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Git 仓库服务搬进 DSH，让 AI 助手直接读写代码、管理版本，开发流程更顺手。

plugins.name: huuthuan-nguyen/dsh-knowcode
plugins.description: Code graph and knowledge base over an embedded FalkorDB: AST symbols, caller/callee tracing, refactor blast radius, affected-test discovery, clone detection, cross-language porting contracts and spec-to-code traceability.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把代码变成可查询的知识图谱，帮你查符号、看重构影响、找重复代码、追需求落地。

plugins.name: dsh-permission-rules
plugins.description: Declarative allow/deny/ask permission rules on the tools/pre-execute waterfall: tool/argument/path/agent matching, session-log audit, dry-run mode, hot reload.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给工具调用加上允许/拒绝/询问的权限规则，还能审计和热更新，防止 AI 乱来。

plugins.name: dsh-visual-edit
plugins.description: Select elements, draw arrows or frame areas in DSH previews, send visual feedback to chat and compare before-and-after snapshots.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在网页预览里圈选元素、画箭头或框选区域，直接给 AI 提修改意见并自动对比前后效果。

plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 凭证文件加上密码保护，用 AES-256-GCM 加密存储，没设密码时照旧明文可用。

plugins.name: dsh-workflow-isolate

plugins.name: dsh-mask

plugins.name: dsh-defend

plugins.descriptionZh: 实时拦截提示词注入、越狱和密钥泄露，给 LLM 应用加一道安全防线

plugins.name: MicroMilo/upstream-radar

plugins.name: dsh-guardian

plugins.descriptionZh: 给 Agent 装个安全护栏，每次工具调用都先审查，敏感操作必须人工确认才放行。

plugins.name: dsh-safeguard
plugins.description: Pre-execution guardrail: vetoes dangerous shell commands and blocks secret/credential leaks before they run.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在命令执行前拦截危险 shell 命令和密钥泄漏，防止工具误操作造成损失。

plugins.description: Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: tiered built-in regex rules (minimal/balanced/aggressive) plus custom patterns rewrite access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders on their way to the session log and the model; one-command install via `dsh plugin add`.

plugins.name: dsh-perm-guard

plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能权限守卫，自动放行安全操作，危险操作需人工确认，兼顾效率与安全。

plugins.name: dsh-mood

plugins.descriptionZh: 在提交代码时自动审查 AI 智能体的改动，拦截密钥泄露、越权修改和提示注入风险，并留下防篡改记录。

plugins.name: accpowered/dsh-auto-review

plugins.descriptionZh: 让智能体严格遵守能力声明，只放行声明过的操作，防止越权滥用权限。

plugins.name: dsh-agentvalet

plugins.name: dream-num/dsh-univer-office
plugins.description: Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment. Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime — with connected data, validation, versioned changes, and isolated worktrees for multi-agent collaboration.

plugins.descriptionZh: 让AI自我纠错有据可查：把重试循环变成可审计的证据链，用确定性门控和互斥假设验证每个结论。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/hooks-adapter
plugins.description: Universal hooks compatibility layer: run hooks declared in Claude Code / Codex / opencode configs on dsh.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的 hooks 配置无缝迁移到 dsh，即插即用，省去重复配置的麻烦。

plugins.name: dsh-overlay-check
plugins.description: Offline overlay safety checks as a zero-dependency library: resolvability preflight, confined managed-block writes, a readable diff, and a warning that `agent-presets.roots` is discarded at boot (deepseek-harness#403).
plugins.descriptionZh: 离线检查 overlay 配置安全性，预检可解析性、限制写入范围、提供可读 diff，并提示启动时被丢弃的配置。

plugins.name: runcat-tommy/dsh-mcp-mini-manager
plugins.description: MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: a Settings page beside Plugins that lists the MCP servers the running loader tree actually holds, each with its config summary, endpoint and live state, and disables or restores any of them through a paired-marker block in the profile's cordis.patch.yml. Env values, header values and `!!js` sources reach the page only as key names or dot-paths.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置里加一页，列出 DSH 实际加载的所有 MCP 服务器及其简介和实时状态，还能逐个移除。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-runcat-inventory
plugins.description: Runcat Plugin Overview (逃咪-插件总览): a better DSH plugin inventory — table view, status filters, enable/disable switches (hot-applied via HMR), config viewer/copy, zh/en UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 用表格管理 DSH 插件，能筛选状态、一键启停热生效，还能查看复制配置，中英文界面自动切换。

plugins.name: duyanta123/dsh-repo-scanner
plugins.description: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs and git facts over a stable JSON schema (CLI + library + skill runbook).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给分析类插件提供只读的仓库扫描内核，快速摸清代码结构、依赖和 Git 信息，输出稳定 JSON 数据。

plugins.name: duyanta123/dsh-test-insight
plugins.description: Test-insight plugin for DeepSeek Harness: turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.
plugins.descriptionZh: 帮你分析测试结果、定位失败原因，让 AI 代理写代码时测试跑得更明白。

plugins.name: LLYlab/DSHEssentialTools
plugins.description: A permanent DeepSeek Harness plugin: project run & code viewer, program snapshots, a VTD conversation tree (edit / retry / branches) with message micro-versions, plus a DET feature manager and global plugin control.
plugins.descriptionZh: DSH 常驻插件，提供工程运行与代码查看、程序版本快照回退，以及虚拟对话树编辑重试，让开发调试更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-darwin
plugins.description: Two-plugin self-evolution loop: dsh-sentinel mines session logs for retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupts and token waste into structured tickets; dsh-forge turns a ticket into a candidate skill behind an eval gate, promotes it into `.dsh/skills` only on human confirmation, and rolls it back deterministically.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动分析会话日志找出重试、报错和浪费，再把问题变成可用的新技能，让插件自己进化。

plugins.name: weibaohui/skills-management
plugins.description: Skill marketplace and manager: manage skills from all local coding agents (10+ executors, incl. Claude Code and Codex) in one page and import them into the DSH skill library; built-in market of 6600+ skills, per-skill token-overhead stats, and model visibility control.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把本地各种编程助手的技能集中到一个页面管理，还能一键导入 DSH 技能库，内置 6600+ 技能市场。

plugins.name: dsh-cert-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server exposing the DSH plugin certification registry: get a certification, list certified plugins, and read the certification spec.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 插件认证信息做成 MCP 服务，让 AI 随时查认证、列已认证插件、读认证规范。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.description: Zero-dependency static + sandbox smoke detector for DSH plugins (R/K/D/CC layers): manifest/patch/entry/build/pack/install verification, a model-callable plugin_check, profile host-shadowing and manifest-BOM detection, and supply-chain poison preflight.
plugins.descriptionZh: 零依赖静态检查加沙箱冒烟测试，帮你在发布前揪出 DSH 插件的各种毛病。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-kit
plugins.description: Shared zero-runtime-dependency toolkit for PerryLink DSH plugins: a pluggable Provider registry seam, fail-closed approval and adaptive session-event gates, mechanical verify scripts, shared sanitize/pricing/judge modules, and a new-plugin skeleton.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 插件开发者用的零依赖工具包，统一 Provider 注册、审批门禁和校验脚本，少写重复代码。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-fde-tools
plugins.description: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (Git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.
plugins.descriptionZh: 装一个插件带一批插件，Git 服务器、WebDAV 挂载盘、知识库、定时任务、自动续跑、界面微调、自动复盘全都有。

plugins.name: dsh-autocompose
plugins.description: Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.
plugins.descriptionZh: 说清任务就自动帮你挑好插件组合，能临时跑一次也能装进主环境长期用。

plugins.name: dsh-pnpm-build-control
plugins.description: Manage pnpm build-script approval across all DSH profiles, including an option to allow every dependency build script, and repair same-Git-URL updates on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键开关所有 DSH 配置的 pnpm 构建脚本审批，还能顺手修复同 Git 地址的更新问题。

plugins.name: ianho7/dsh-port-inspector
plugins.description: Windows local development port attribution and safe handling for verified DSH services.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH Web 里追踪 Windows 本地端口被哪个进程占用，并安全处理已确认的 DSH 服务。

plugins.name: Oscar-Williams/dsh-deepcanary
plugins.description: Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness: C0–C3 policies, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地注意力监督，优先呈现关键证据，静默通知并汇总可操作事项，帮你专注重要信息。

plugins.name: sandbase-harness
plugins.description: Persistent managed-agent runtime for DSH via a native bundle and stdio MCP, with sandboxed sessions, audit, and replay.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 提供持久化托管 Agent 运行时，支持沙箱隔离、操作审计与回放，让 Agent 安全稳定地长期运行。

plugins.name: dsh-launch
plugins.description: Detached-broker supervision of long-running services (dev servers, watchers, mock APIs) that survive turns, sessions and DSH restarts, with a Service sidebar tab (registered via better-sidebar's extension API) and service_start/stop/restart/list/logs model tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让长驻服务跨会话持续运行，对话结束也不中断，省去反复启动的麻烦。

plugins.name: dsh-env-switcher
plugins.description: One-click Windows/WSL2 environment switcher for DSH (coexistence mode): both environments run simultaneously on separate ports and switch from the web UI without killing any process.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 Windows 和 WSL2 之间一键切换 DeepSeek Harness 环境，让两者共存互不干扰。

plugins.name: dsh-payload-capture
plugins.description: Capture every upstream model API payload to JSON (debug & observability).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把上游模型 API 的请求和响应数据完整抓取为 JSON，方便调试和监控。

plugins.name: dsh-observation-journal
plugins.description: Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动记录每次会话的运行报告，包括任务、模型、工具、耗时和状态，无需手动干预，方便复盘和排查问题。

plugins.name: dsh-workloads
plugins.description: Workspace-owned durable process supervision, readiness checks, and a Runtime Center for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区级常驻进程守护、健康检查与运行时管理中心，让长任务稳定可见、易管理。

plugins.name: dsh-doctor
plugins.description: Profile health check: finds config fields a patch dropped by whole-config replacement, patches targeting missing entry ids, and tool-name collisions.
plugins.descriptionZh: 检查 DeepSeek Harness 配置健康度，帮你揪出补丁丢失、目标缺失和工具重名等问题。

plugins.name: chouyong/dsh-effect-doctor
plugins.description: Isolated cleanup verifier for Cordis-managed runtime resources, producing deterministic receipts after plugin teardown.
plugins.descriptionZh: 验证 Cordis 管理的运行时资源在挂载、使用、卸载后能恢复基线，确保生命周期干净无泄漏。

plugins.name: dsh-dock
plugins.description: Windows desktop launcher plugin: prebuilt whale exe opens the DSH Web UI as a fullscreen Edge app (token health gate, cold-start card); a sidebar More menu adds Settings/Reload/Full Exit, which stops the server and closes the window.
plugins.descriptionZh: 双击桌面鲸鱼图标就能全屏打开 DSH 网页版，托盘常驻看状态、一键重启退出，不用再敲命令行。

plugins.name: dsh-xray
plugins.description: Composition X-ray for DSH: attribute every booted row to the layer that introduced it, diff declared vs actual trees (catching patch rows dsh silently skips), service dependency graph with disable-cascade, per-plugin lifecycle health, tool-schema token cost, and a heuristic capability audit of out-of-tree plugins; static commands work even when dsh cannot boot, and an `xray_composition` tool lets agents introspect their own capability set.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 启动过程拍 X 光，看清每行配置来自哪一层，对比声明与实际差异，排查被悄悄跳过的补丁。

plugins.name: fancr-code/dsh-tray-launcher
plugins.description: Windows system-tray launcher: windowless `dsh web` with a tray menu (open UI/log, exit = full quit), preset icons (Liangzu / whale-girl / DeepSeek) plus custom, one-line npm install.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 dsh web 变成 Windows 托盘小图标，无窗口后台运行，点菜单就能开界面、看日志、一键退出。

plugins.name: dsh-quickstart
plugins.description: Windows desktop launcher (zero-dependency npm CLI): double-click a desktop shortcut to start dsh web with zero console windows and auto-open the browser once ready.
plugins.descriptionZh: 双击桌面快捷方式即可启动 DeepSeek Harness Web，无控制台弹窗，自动打开浏览器，省心又高效。

plugins.name: dsh-observe
plugins.description: Observability exporter for DSH: turn/step/tool/LLM spans and token/cost metrics from the session/event stream to OTLP and Langfuse, with sanitized prompt/completion capture, async batching, a bounded durable offline buffer, and retry with backoff — off by default.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 会话里的调用链路、耗时和 token 花费导出到 OTLP 和 Langfuse，方便随时盯住模型表现和成本。

plugins.name: dsh-win32
plugins.description: Native Windows shell and Workspace Write sandbox presets for DSH without WSL, using busybox-w32 for sandboxed sessions and Git Bash for unrestricted sessions, with setup diagnostics.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 Windows 上补齐 DeepSeek Harness 缺失的进程管理能力，支持持久 Git Bash 终端、Ctrl-C 中断注入和安装陷阱修复。

plugins.name: loongsuite/dsh-plugin
plugins.description: OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing for DSH: one span tree per turn (steps, LLM calls with TTFT, tool executions, token usage), exported over standard OTLP to any compatible backend, content capture off by default.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 每轮对话生成 OpenTelemetry 调用链，看清步骤、模型耗时和工具执行，还能导出到任意 OTLP 后端。

plugins.name: dsh-restart
plugins.description: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键重启整个 DSH 进程，重新加载插件和配置，还能设置重启后自动继续、看门狗自动拉起。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cleaner
plugins.description: Delete sessions from a running web runtime: live store, workspace records, and on-disk artifacts (no restart needed).
plugins.descriptionZh: 无需重启即可清理运行中 DeepSeek Harness 的会话数据，包括文件、存储和记录，方便管理。

plugins.name: dsh-config-manager
plugins.description: Backup / export / import / migrate the whole DSH configuration as one portable ZIP, restore it on any machine with one click (host engine + Web UI).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把整个 DSH 配置打包成一个 ZIP，换台机器一键还原，备份迁移都省心。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-config-manager@$(npm view dsh-config-manager version)"

plugins.name: dshp
plugins.description: Profile manager: list, create, clone and diff profiles, and export a whole setup (bundle order, plugin versions, patch) as one portable file.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键管理 DeepSeek Harness 配置：创建、克隆、对比配置文件，还能把整套环境打包成单个文件随身带走。

plugins.name: dsh-backup
plugins.description: One-command backup & restore of ~/.dsh user data: /backup commands plus a backup_dsh tool and Settings panel, sha256 verify with hardened restore screening (path-traversal/symlink rejection), restart-surviving scheduled auto-backup, rotation, loopback download route, and private-repo GitHub sync.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一条命令备份和恢复 ~/.dsh 用户数据，带校验与安全筛查，换机迁移更省心。

plugins.name: dsh-fast
plugins.description: Read-only performance diagnostics: session load timing, spill hits, compaction stats, context-injection volume, and cache-hit rate via the /fast command and fast_report tool, sampled asynchronously off the model path.
plugins.descriptionZh: 通过 /fast 命令和 fast_report 工具，异步采样分析会话加载耗时、缓存命中率等性能指标，帮你快速定位性能瓶颈。

plugins.name: Zn-Dk/dsh-session-repair
plugins.description: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL artifact validation (header, seq, tool-call IDs, turn/step closure), deterministic repair of empty tool-call ID chains, single-slot pre-repair backup + restore, and an audit trail.
plugins.descriptionZh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的DSH会话历史，支持备份和可信检查点，防止数据丢失。

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-sentry
plugins.description: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search and detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace that drops local variables, request data, and secret-looking tags.
plugins.descriptionZh: 只读查看 Sentry 问题和事件，帮你快速排查错误，不写不改只读数据。

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-grafana-query
plugins.description: Read-only Grafana tools over the data source proxy: instance health, data sources, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert state, and provisioned alert rules.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让智能体通过 Grafana 只读查询指标和告警，用 PromQL 直接拉数据，方便监控和排查。

plugins.name: dsh-autotier
plugins.description: Automatic strong/cheap model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: intent-gated tier landing on the agent/request waterfall, plan-mode handoff (strong plans, cheap implements), deterministic high-risk guards, failure escalation with TTL fallback, a /tier command, and tier status tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动给 DeepSeek Harness 的请求分配强/弱模型档位，让强模型做规划、便宜模型干活，省钱又不掉质量。

plugins.name: runcat-tommy/dsh-windows-c-cleanup
plugins.description: Windows system-drive (C:) cleanup: rule-based scan, five-tier safety grading, a staging area with a rollback ledger, UAC elevation, and migration to another drive — a model tool plus a Web GUI panel.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键清理 Windows C 盘：规则扫描、分级安全评估、可回滚暂存，还能把大文件搬到别的盘。

plugins.name: dsh-circuit-breaker
plugins.description: Deterministic loop guard: denies a tool call repeated with identical arguments and caps per-agent calls, in code outside the model; incident log lets a parent interrupt a stuck subagent.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个循环保险，拦住重复的工具调用并限制单个智能体的调用次数，防止模型卡死或烧钱。

plugins.name: ymck-x/dsh-skill-starter
plugins.description: Skill manager with 6 built-in skills and a 20-skill Chinese engineering pack (requirements grilling, ticketing, TDD, two-axis code review, retro), grouped by the situation you are in; upgrading a pack never overwrites files you edited.
plugins.descriptionZh: 装完就有 6 个基础技能加 20 个工程流程技能，设置页和对话里都能直接读写，升级不覆盖你改过的文件。

plugins.name: dsh-mimir
plugins.description: Research-lifecycle workbench (7-view web panel): arXiv search/import/subscriptions with AI relevance scoring, Zotero import, experiment tracking with SSH/GPU remote jobs, LaTeX write-compile-snapshot studio with 11 venue templates, figure management, and one-click group-meeting PPT decks with real paper figures; 10 bundled research skills (npm: `dsh-mimir`).
plugins.descriptionZh: 一站式科研工作台，边写LaTeX边编译，管理文献、追踪实验、调度GPU集群，搞定科研全流程。

plugins.name: dsh-fund-research
plugins.description: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds: public-source data collection (Tiantian Fund/Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动抓取天天基金等公开数据，生成公募基金确定性研究报告，含业绩拆解和持仓穿透分析。

plugins.name: pengpengyi92/dsh-quant
plugins.description: Agent-native quantitative R&D toolkit for DSH: 59 tools across 6 domains (data, alpha, ML, risk, execution, ecosystem) with an end-to-end PDAT→PET research pipeline.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一站式量化投研工具包，覆盖数据、因子、机器学习、风控与回测，让智能体轻松搞定量化研究全流程。

plugins.name: dsh-wsl-native
plugins.description: Use Windows and native Linux DSH sessions in one Windows window, with environment switching and bidirectional system tools; requires WSL 2 and Node.js on both systems.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在同一个 Windows 窗口里同时用 Windows 和原生 Linux 对话，一键切换环境，草稿和任务各自保留。

plugins.name: skyjjgw/dsh-version-guard
plugins.description: Snapshots plugin versions and profile configuration, with an independent recovery page to restore a known-good configuration when DSH cannot start.
plugins.descriptionZh: 装插件把 DSH 搞崩了打不开？用它回退到上一个可用版本，不用进 DSH 也能救。

plugins.name: dsh-compat-guardian
plugins.description: Detect DSH plugin conflicts and loading failures, quarantine affected bundles and recover them, with offline startup rescue.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动检查 DSH 插件兼容性，出问题就隔离并恢复，还能离线救急启动。

plugins.name: maddogfinance/dsh-trading
plugins.description: Research-only trading workbench plugins: typed market-data seam (bring your own provider), multi-timeframe indicator regime snapshot, interactive chart cards in dsh web with provenance-gated model annotations, and a risk-guard that blocks execution-shaped tool calls at the pre-execute gate.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的交易研究插件，提供市场数据接入、多周期指标快照和交互式图表卡片，方便你快速分析行情。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/mattpocock-skills-dsh
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code review, wayfinder, ask-matt router) ported to DSH.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Matt Pocock 的 25 个 AI 编程技能搬到 DSH，涵盖代码审查、TDD、提问路由等，开箱即用。

plugins.name: weopenfire-git/dsh-market-quote
plugins.description: A-share / HK / US realtime quotes and historical K-line tool plugin via Tencent's free public source (no API key), read-only.
plugins.descriptionZh: 免密钥查 A股、港股、美股实时行情和历史 K 线，给 Agent 提供结构化数据。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/dsh-ponytail
plugins.description: Ponytail, lazy senior dev mode: 6 skills (ponytail, ponytail-audit, ponytail-debt, ponytail-gain, ponytail-help, ponytail-review) adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把资深老油条的偷懒哲学做成 6 个技能，帮你砍需求、查技术债、审代码，少写无用代码。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/dsh-ecc
plugins.description: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 273 个 ECC 技能搬进 DSH，分四批装好，开箱就能用。

plugins.name: dsh-trading-toolkit
plugins.description: A-share and US stock trading toolkit for DSH agents: realtime quotes, OHLCV klines, ADX regime signals and simple backtest previews via EastMoney. Read-only, never places orders.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 智能体用的 A 股美股行情工具，实时报价、K线、ADX 信号和回测预览，只读不下单。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/mattpocock-skills-dsh-zh
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's 25 skills fully translated to Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Matt Pocock 的 25 个实用技能全部翻译成中文，方便中文开发者直接上手使用。

plugins.name: jackControls/dsh-noBS-CAD-step
plugins.description: 2D engineering prints (PDF/PNG/JPG) of plate parts to noBS CAD scripts and STEP files: modelling skill, CAD tools over the noBS CAD MCP engine, packed native print probe, and a 2D → 3D panel in the Web UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把板材零件的二维工程图（PDF/图片）转成 CAD 脚本和 STEP 三维模型，看图建模一步到位。

plugins.name: dsh-news-briefing
plugins.description: News briefing skill: 5-dimension scoring (story/timeliness/depth/fun/uniqueness), anti-clickbait writing rules, Tier-based content preference, de-AI-style Chinese writing guide.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动采集多源新闻，按五个维度打分筛选，写出不标题党的中文早报晚报。

plugins.name: LAU-MARS/dsh-cad
plugins.description: CAD viewer and OCCT parametric modeling tools (primitives, extrusion, booleans, fillets, engineering drawings, assemblies) with an interactive 3D/2D panel in the Web UI; STEP/STL export.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接处理 CAD 图纸，用 AI 轻松搞定二维三维建模与修改。

plugins.name: easyeda-agent

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-media-gen
